comments: Great appartment, clean and well equipped in a perfect location in San telmo! And of course, an excellent host!

Nous avons été ravis de notre séjour dans cet appartement, la chambre au top, super propre et belle deco,  super cuisine, une machine à laver , très bon emplacement ! Et la gentillesse de Valentin incomparable ! Safe et super quartier ! Nous serions restés plus si nous avions plus de temps !
The host canceled this reservation 2 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Wonderful cozy apartment in Almagro. It had everything I needed, nice fast Internet and excellent AC. I would highly recommend! Mauro was a very gracious host.
Buen lugar, excelente ubicacion, Judith muy atenta siempre, espero volver!

Sebastian’s loft is in a great location in the heart of Recoleta. It’s a safe and beautiful atmosphere with a pool overlooking the city. We were met by Sebastian’s wife who helped us get set up and provided us with tips on things to do. Everything was easy to get to and the loft was great.

Perfect location for public transport and a gorgeous terrace that catches lots of sun. Patricia went the extra mile to ensure I was comfortable, even buying tea bags for me as I am english! I will be back next time I visit.
No pude conocer a Oscar personalmente, pero por wasap siempre estuvo en contacto y fue muy amable. Estuvo pendiente de lo que hacia y recomendaciones A1
Impecable el departamento, muy completo y los anfitriones excelentes. Lo recomiendo!!

Great apartment. It’s in an old building, but it’s newly renovated and clean. Walking distance to Porto Madero and microcentro. The pics corresponded to the reality, and the host was very available and easy to communicate. Would stay here again.
100% recomendado. Es precioso y super bien ubicado!!!

Daniel welcomed my boyfriend, my brother and myself warmly, we really appreciated it. The apartment is totally new and confortable, and it was perfectly cleaned. It is also well furnished and well located. We strongly recommend Daniel’s apartment.

El dpto es cómodo, para 1 o 2 personas, está muy bien ubicado con todo cerca.  En invierno es cálido y luminoso porque da todo el sol durante la mañana y medio día ayudado por el aire acond. frio/calor. Los vecinos son bastante tranquilos respecto de los ruidos aunque los camiones del Ceanse molestan bastante durante la noche pero es un problema gral de la zona y no del dpto, quizás un doble vidrio ayudaría. El dpto es lindo, para un dos ambientes pequeño y esta bien equipado. Las terminaciones del edificio son de baja calidad en gral.
muy lindo el lugar, ubicación excelente. El departamento es mu acogedor, la cama cómoda, todo en excelente estado! La dueña de casa muy atenta y buena disposición!! Muy recomedable!!
Agradezco la hospitalidad y recomiendo para aquellos que no les importa tomar el metro. Ambiente muy tranquilo.
The host canceled this reservation 87 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
el departamento es bonito, seguro y en una zona inmejorable. Además Ezequiel es muy amable

O apartamento da Barbara é ótimo! Muito confortável e fica no Centro perto de tudo, restaurantes, cafés, perto do Obelisco, perto de metrô, da para se locomover para qualquer lugar facilmente. Adoramos nossa estadia.

Apto super aconchegante, limpo, e bem esquipado! Podem reservar sem medo!
Atenciosas, respostas rapidas!! Amei
Ubicación exelente, muy cómodo y tienes todo a tu alcance.
Todo perfecto. Excelente ubicación, personal muy amable y la habitación con aire acondicionado
Great location, nice communication.
Bonito lugar, limpio y cómodo en pleno centro de Buenos Aires
It’s all in the details. Everything regarding the stay was thoughtful. Ralf was extremely accommodating and courteous. Couldn’t have had a better stay. Thanks Ralf!
The host canceled this reservation 20 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Good value. Good location.
Muy iluminado naturalmente y con buena ventilación. Recomendable

We did enjoy our stay at Rene's place very much. The apartment looks in person better than in the pictures, the quality of the furnishings and details were fantastic, including the mattress, sheets, an espresso machine and more! We contacted Rene a few times and he was very responsive and had a good support network to promptly take care of our requests. Would love to be there again next time.

The place is very nice. It has a great view, a comfortable bed, nice shower and a comfy couch. The location is close to a lot of things and even though the metro is a little far, there are buses that stop nearby. Also thanks Syl for being helpful and responding to us fast.

Passei uma semana no apartamento da Emília. Fui muito bem recebida pela Senhora Olga, mãe da Emília, que nos deu todo apoio. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, com fácil acesso a vários pontos da cidade e ônibus na porta. Tudo estava limpo e bem cuidado e Emília foi muito gentil, oferecendo café, açúcar, refrigerante gelado. Foi uma semana muito agradável. Recomendo!
Beautiful place... I really recommend it
Place really situated in the heart of San Telmo neighborhood, easy to get and easy to live!

Very stylish and authentic place. Loved the location and easy walking to markets, restaurants and subway. Surprisingly quiet and relaxing considering there is abit of night life. Rooftop patio is a big plus. We recommend the place.
Excelentes anfitrionas, tanto Agustina como su mamá. El departamento es tal cual se muestra, excelente ubicación.

Gus was a great host the entire time we were down there. Any questions we had, he promptly responded to us, set up our transportation to/from the airport, and gave us plenty of suggestions of things to do around the city
Noelia y su hermano son muy atentos, están pendiente de los detalles y hacen tu estadía mucho más comoda.
Recomendado 100%!! ubicación, limpieza, comunicación, comodidades...  no tuvimos ningun problema, al contrario! Mara es muy atenta, sin dudas lo vuelvo a elegir.
La ubicación es muy buena, la respuesta de Matías es inmejorable, el espacio demuestra que es habitado y uno llega a ese espacio a seguir habitándolo.
The host canceled this reservation 38 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Un lindo departamento, limpio, cómodo y bien ubicado!!!

Brilliant location near cool spots in Palermo Soho. Communication was great, we checked in very late and was fine. Zulma got someone round straight away to fix an issue with the blinds when we mentioned it. Small, simple apartment but good value for location.

Tremendous location if you want to experience the San Telmo area of Buenos Aires, one of the oldest parts of the city.  The apartment is as advertised, nice studio with all the essentials, and the rooftop terrace is a great plus for unwinding at the end of the day.
El espacio de Ruy es muy confortable, sin dudas volvería a elegirlo! Y además es un excelente anfitrión, muchas gracias por tu atención!

Super recomendable , el apto es hermoso , comodidad al 100 % , confort y estilo , cerca de todo , Claudia su anfitriona  es una genia, sabe lo que hace y tiene claro  lo que necesitan los viajeros para que su estancia sea óptima y única !!

Sadly I only spent one night in Antoine's place but I wish I could have stayed longer!  The house is ideally situated in the gorgeous leafy green Palermo Hollywood neighborhood close to loads of great bars and restaurants. Antoine and his wife Leti were lovely and welcoming and gave me some great insider tips. The place itself is very stylish, clean and comfortable with lots of natural light and there's an amazing private roof terrace with lots of plants that feels like a little peaceful oasis in the city. Would definitely recommend!

What a great spot. Roof top terrace with private jacuzzi is icing on the cake. Check in and out was seamless, Soledad is available if you need her. Location is fantastic, our first time to Buenos Airies, we were unsure of what part of town to stay in. Palmero Soho is excellent- close to many bars, restaurants, sights, etc. We walked everywhere. Streets are safe at night with so many great places to stop and grab a bite.

We were met at the accommodation, everything was explained to us and we were left with emails and telephone numbers in case of any problems. The neighbourhood is lively and bohemian, lots of classy bars and hidden restaurants, boutiques and cafés.
Best points: roof terrace, lots of space, plenty of hot water, location.
Worst points: dogs barking at night, very loud weekend parties at nearby houses. Noisy neighbour next door.
Impecable el departamento, excelente ubicación y el anfitrión siempre disponible.

La ubicación es excelente, a una cuadra de la estación de tren y subte y relativamente cerca de la zona de bares. Me costó obtener respuestas por parte de los anfitriones y no pude usar la pileta durante la estadía. Buscar la llave del depto después de las 20:30 cuesta 20USD. El departamento es muy cómodo para 2 personas, tiene una linda vista y lo encontramos muy limpio.

Das Studio liegt mitten in Recoleta und damit fährt man sehr gut, weil es das sicherste Viertel in Buenos Aires ist. Alles war unkompliziert und ging reibungslos über die Bühne. Studio ist sauber, groß und man alles was man braucht. Highlight ist mit Sicherheit der Pool auf dem Dach. Absolute Weiterempfehlung.
Excelente, fue un viaje corto por trabajo, el lugar impecable! Delfina excelente anfitriona!

Silvina e sua filha Bahiana firam excelentes anfitriãs. o apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos, antigo mais muito limpo. Havia produtos de higiene e limpeza a nossa disposição.  Bahiana nos recebeu em nossa chegada e nos mostrou o apartamento. a localização é excelente. no bairro há vários mercadinhos e bons lugares para comer. é próximo de uma estação de metro e pudemos chegar a todos os pontos turísticos rapidamente. era nosso aniversario de casamento e Silvina nos deixou uma garrafa de chandon como presente, uma delicadeza muito atenciosa. nos sentimos em casa!

Christian nos hizo sentir muy bien. El departamento está muy bien ubicado, en un edificio seguro y en una zona privilegiada. Las fotos coinciden exactamente con el lugar. Está muy bien cuidado y tiene todas las condiciones para poder disfrutar de Buenos Aires sin preocupaciones. Christian estuvo al tanto de todos los detalles, atendiendo todas nuestras necesidades y preocupado por nuestra estancia. Lo recomiendo, no se van a arrepentir de haberlo elegido.

Nos gustó todo. Desde la limpieza, la comodidad que tiene el lugar, no le falta nada, la ubicación en San Telmo. El baño es un lujo, la cocina es completa con utensilios, microondas, heladera. El trato con Juan es un súper Host nos ayudó todo el tiempo. Nos vamos con la promesa que cuando volvamos a Buenos Aires nos quedaremos en este Studio otra vez.

this is a wonderful apartment!  spacious, plenty of storage for our clothes, great shower and bathroom, great kitchen, washer, and we especially liked when weather permitted us to have our meals on the balcony overlooking the intersection.  It was only a few minutes walk to the end of the block to catch the Subte, a supermarket was a half block away, and a fresh vegetable store close too - i highly recommend Tomas' place!

El departamento es acogedor el muy luminoso es tal cual las fotos, sin embargo el jacuzzi estaba lleno de tierra sucio por los lados no se puede usar y va visita a los vecinos no es privado y el wifi no indica cual es el usuario de red sólo cual la clave. Detalles a tener en cuenta
muy buen lugar, aunque esta lejos centro, para que queres ir al centro todo el tiempo. pasea por Belgrano, barrio chino, barracas nuñez. es mas lindo.

Location, Location, Location....if you are interested in an authentic neighborhood experience in Buenos Aires outside the usual tourist area, this two bedroom apartment with kitchen will exceed your expectations.  We are foodies from San Francisco, interested in good restaurants, easy access to transportation, and the safe tree lined streets of Palermo.  Melisa was an excellent hostess, and her generous hospitality certainly exceeded our expectations.  In addition to meeting us at the apartment, we counted on her expertise to help us learn the neighborhood and arrange taxis for us.  We do not speak Spanish, and with her support we had a most delightful experience in her beautiful city.  The two bedrooms are very comfortable, just like the photos.  You will find plenty of storage, hot water, kitchen supplies, coffee pot, very comfortable beds and pillows. There is an elevator, air conditioner, and good wifi.  We will definitely stay here the next time we are in Buenos Aires.
Es un monoambiente con todo lo necesario. Para dos personas es ideal y máximo 3. Todo super limpio y 100% de usabilidad

Pasamos unas tres semanas muy lindas en el departamento, esta como en las fotos, el check in con la mama de German funcionó muy bien, nos recibió bien. El lugar estuvo limpio, la ubicacion esta buena, dentro de todo un lugar que recomiendo! 
Tuvimos una pequeña discussión con el dueño el primer día, pero después de que se arregló, todo bien. :)

We had such a wonderful time at Emilce's place! It was so lovely to be greeted by Emilce, too! The place was fantastic and perfectly situated in Palermo. We were there for the holidays (summer) and the gorgeous rooftop and pool were fabulous. We hope to be back at Emilce's when we return one day to Buenos!
Muy cerca del subte y locomoción lindo barrio, seguro con todas las comodidades, excelentes bares y restaurantes lo pasamos genial recomendable  %

Realmente muy cómodo el departamento de Alejandro. Limpio, luminoso y en un excelente punto de Buenos Aires. Alejandro en todo momento se preocupó por que no nos faltara nada. Muy placentera estadía en Recoleta.
Excelente departamento, buena ubicación,  los vigilantes de la recepción muy amable. Departamento muy cómodo!
Ubicación increíble! Ana una genia! Y el lugar muy bueno y completo! Para recomendar!
Lugar con excelente ubicación, destacada servicialidad y atención por parte de Gabriel y la esposa. La estancia se hace muy amena en todo momento. Muy recomendado.

El lugar está en una zona residencial, cómodo y acogedor, nos sentimos seguros .
Es fácil transportarse en el subterráneo.

Leila es muy atenta y amable a la hora de hacerte sentir en casa. La ubicación de la habitación es inmejorable, las condiciones del edificio. Las fotos corresponden a la realidad. Hay muchos sitios de comida, ventas y sitios turísticos cercanos al lugar, el famoso Obelisco, es un ejemplo de ello. Lo único malo no habernos quedado mayor tiempo. Excelente anfitriona y hace un chocolate de bariloche muy rico.

The apartment was just as described. Very clean and within several blocks to anything you may need. Very close to transit. Camilo was very friendly and was quick to respond if I needed anything. Highly recommend! 

El departmento estaba como se describe. Muy limpio y dentro de varias cuadras de todo lo que pueda necesitar. Muy cerca de tránsito. Camilo fue muy amable y fue rápido para responder si necesitaba algo. ¡Recomendado mucho!
Lugar cómodo, cerca de lugares interesantes. El depto muy lindo.
Los anfitriones se mostraron muy atentos y predispuestos en todo momento. Departamento espacioso, bien ubicado y muy limpio.

Marina is a wonderful host. We been to unique local designer shops that I won’t be able to find them myself.  If you love to dress other than mainstream stuff, I wholeheartedly recommend to shop with marina

Clean, nicely furbished and spacious, the apartment is ideally located in the very nice neighbourhood of Palermo. Moreover our hosts were nice, always giving prompt answers. I would recommend this apartment !
Yael es muy buena anfitriona. Responde rapido y nos recomendo lugares de interes!! Muy predispuesta. Y el dpto.. muy bien ubicado! Lo recomiendo

My boyfriend and I stayed at Cristian's place in Palermo for nearly two months and absolutely loved it. The apartment is as it looks in the photos and feels quite spacious. The kitchen is well equipped for cooking, the balcony is great for morning reading and the bedroom is in the back of the apartment, away from most of the street noise. The location is also ideal as you are a few blocks from the subte, near lots of bus lines and walking distance to everything in Palermo Soho and Hollywood. The restaurants, bars and cafés in this neighborhood are top notch. Even with two months we feel like we didn't have enough time to try them all. The wifi works very well and the neighbors are pleasant. During our stay there were a few little things that started falling apart, but nothing major and this did not take away from our experience. Overall, two thumbs up! I would highly suggest you take advantage of Cristian's apartment, whether for a few days or a few months.
They had an issue with wifi they couldn't resolve by the time we've check in. As we went on Friday, we did not have connectivity for the whole weekend.
Lugar ótimo, super limpo, localização perfeita. Perto de muitos pubs, e de vários ônibus e a principal estação de trem de Buenos Aires.
Excelente departamento! Muy limpio, todo como está en fotos. Juli siempre a disposición para todo. Super recomendable!
La diferencia la hace la anfitriona. Uno se siente seguro con sus indicaciones y detalle. Muy amable y muy buena experiencia.
graciass
Departamento muy bien iluminado, fresco y moderno. Nos sentimos muy comodas y los anfitriones muy hospitalarios.
Todo Perfecto! Como siempre que me alejo en el departamento de Dolores , espero poder volver el próximo mes !
Sabrina es una excelente anfitriona y la ubicación es inmejorable, además de tranquila.
La verdad que el lugar, la ubicación es hermosa. La predisposición de la dueña fue siempre fluida.

Nous avons aimé cet appartement par sa proximité à tout, avec une ligne de tram à 5minutes à pied. 
Il est confortable pour 2 adultes avec trois enfants (nous étions 5 adultes c’était un un peu limite). Nous étions contents des sanitaires, de la propreté et de l’accueil de notre hôte qui a été accueillante patiente et agréable alors que notre avion avait du retard et qu’une fois en route nous n’avions plus de réseau. Merci beaucoup nous avons passé une bonne semaine chez elle :)
Muchas gracias Noelia por todo! El lugar superó nuestras expectativas

The studio apartment is as you can see it on the photos. It's well located, but take into account that it's a restricted area for access by car (particularly on weekdays). If you are looking for a place to sleep, have access to the main attractions and try restaurants/bars, is the perfect choice. But if you like to prepare your own meal you'll note that is lacking some items (particularly hobs, in my opinion). Over all great experience.
Perfect organisation, quick response in case of need, easy hand-over. Great location for day- and nightlife in young Buenos Aires.

La ubicación es excelente, lleno de comercios alrededor. Buena comida (les recomiendo La Conga, sobre esa misma calle) y tiendas para abastecerse. La recamarera es de las personas más amables que he conocido, igualmente Damián. Muy recomendable.
Great place. Recommend it

Amazing place, very well located. The best was Luz and her Husband, they are extremely kind persons and always willing to help. 
The room was very clean and really makes you feel like home.  Very advisable to stay there.

Great place to stay for easy access to both Palermo Soho and Hollywood. 
- Very helpful and accommodating around check in/out.
- Good WiFi, nice shower, lift access.

La amabilidad de Andrea y la comunicación con ella, fue excelente, fluida y rápido. La zona del alojamiento es muy buena, con muchos lugares para comer o salir de copas. 
El lugar, muy cómodo en cuanto a espacio y luminosidad. 
Realmente recomendable.
Súper cómodo espacio y bien ubicado
Sympathic contact who takes care of the guest. The apartment with the entrance to the patio (shared with other apartments) is very nice as well as the patio is nicely designed!
Departamento cómodo y funcional, muy bien ubicado e ideal para pasar unos días en la Ciudad. Laura y su mamá se comunicaron muy cordialmente y de manera rápida con nosotros.

Perfect location in the heart of Palermo, close to major public transport routes (2 blocks to metrobus, 3 blocks to subte linea D, train station and city buses). Distrito Arcos Outlet with lots of brands across the street. Apartment has a stove with oven so you can cook something if you'd like to. Fastest internet connection I've seen in BA so far. New building, quiet place, few blocks away from BA night buzz.

The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, lovely. We went with my husband and our 3 kids and we fit in it perfectly. It is as you see in the pictures and really bright. The apartment has everything you need to enjoy your stay in Bs As . It is close to all kind of stores, perfect transport communication. Building Amenities are just perfect, doorman, security, laundry, gym and sauna. We love the kindness of people working in the building and of course Ana, the owner. I do recommend this apartment, you will be happy in it. Also important, you have silence and blackout to sleep well plus is warm. Thank you very much Ana!

Stunning Apartment is a correct description. This apartment is absolutely gorgeous, decorated with very chic artwork and has historic charm throughout. Though we visited in the winter (the coldest week of the year), Nicolas was accommodating with extra heaters and blankets so we could enjoy the lovely rooms in this apartment. Without this, we would have been very cold. 

The apartment is historic, so please find the beauty in the older features (i.e. bathroom tiles and flooring) the way that we did. 

Everything in the apartment and surrounding areas is just as described. We had a fantastic time and would absolutely stay here again.

Fantastic place right in the heart of Buenos Aires. Very stylish place including two fancy bathrooms and a spacious living area. Loved the amazing rooftop balcony. Juli is a lovely host. She provided us with tipps and was always happy to help. Can only recommend staying at her place.
El local es ótimo, precio accesible y Maria es una excelente persona y muy simpática para recibir sus huéspedes. Local totalmente recomendable.

Betina’s apartment is beautiful, well-located, safe, and has a great deal of personality. The photos are completely accurate. As she was travelling, we sadly didn’t have the chance to meet Betina but nonetheless she was very responsive from halfway across the world over the course of our 1 month stay. The neighbors were also very helpful and welcoming. A great experience and an easy 5/5. Gracias Betina!
Emma was a very helpful and kind host and the appartment was just perfect!

Apartamento recien remodelado. Buena ubicación y amplio para lo que se encuentra por la zona. 
Muy recomendable !

Centrally located, you can get to many interesting points by foot or buses and subways, it is very convenient and friendly neighbourhood.  I love the building, it was built in 1920 and still maintain the elegance.  The apartment is exactly as seen in photos, very spacious and clean.  A bit noisy in the daytime on the weekdays but weekend is very quiet.  Matias is a wonderful host, he provides very detailed tourists information and answers difficult questions in a split second.  He is also very helpful in ad hoc request,  he helped me to find out bank location, where I can find supermarket and post office etc.  He also helped arranging a car for me to go to the airport at midnight for catching an red eye flight.  Must say thank you to Matias here and will definite return on my next visit.
Excelente ubicación!

As always, Gloria is a great host! We keep coming month after month!
thanks Gloria!
Muy limpio y muy buena ubicación.
Reserve el alojamiento de Gabriela para mi hermana y su novio , y volvieron super contentos ! Muy calido el dpto y super amable la atencion de Gabriela. Para recomendar 100%

El loft es muy confortable, luminoso, bien protegido del ruido y en muy buena ubicación. Un lugar que asegura una estancia agradable. Alejandra nos recibió y explicó lo necesario de manera amable y detallada. Una gran anfitriona. Muy recomendable.

Leticia y Juan son unos excelentes anfitriones!!
El departamento se encuentra a pasos de Calle Corrientes, en una estupenda ubicación con línea de transportes, para poder recorrer la ciudad!El departamento con un estilo único, super luminoso y confortable, con todo lo que un huésped puede nesecitar
Gracias!

Ce logement est très bien situé et très agréable (calme tout en étant au centre de Telmo). José Luis vous accueille avec le sourire et est très agréable! Seul bémol, la douche, nous avons rencontré des difficultés pour avoir de l'eau chaude. Tout le reste était très bien, propre, lit confortable.

Can I just move into this cute apartment and live here forever!?!? IT’S ABSOLUTELY ADORABLE AND IN THE MOST AMAZING NEIGHBORHOOD!!!! 
I love the open layout and big windows! It really allows you to connect with the city and views. We really enjoyed waking up every morning, making a cup of delicious argentine coffee, and sitting on the comfy patio furniture! But don’t worry if you are a light sleeper, the blinds close perfectly and you can sleep till noon… Which we might’ve done once or twice ;) after all the fun night out dancing and drinking! 
This is definitely the neighborhood you want to be in if you are a foodie. We had so much fun exploring the streets and all the delicious food… Not to forget the beautiful Malbecs ❤️. 
If you love sushi, I’ve been to japan 3 times, and want the most amazing meal of your life..... try OSAKA. It’s a bit pricey, but totally worth it!!!!  It’s sushi with a Peruvian twist. GLORIOUS!!! 
The neighborhood is extremely safe and on a fairly quiet street. However it is very close to all the hotspots of Palermo SoHo. If you are into fashion that’s definitely where you want to hit up. They had the most amazing unique artisans and independent boutiques! If you love handmade bespoke shoes... you MUST check out CHICCO RUIZ!!!!! They are works of art, handmade by a lovely gal who sustainability resources all the materials from her home town. Tell her I sent you ;-) 

Our hosts were Spectacular!!! Great communication! And extremely kind and generous!!! Sadly we never got to meet face to face... but I have a feeling we would make great friends!!!! I DO plan to return to Buenos Aires someday and hopefully rent this adorable apartment again!

Perks: super comfy bed! (Website hidden by Airbnb) Great AC (Website hidden by Airbnb) Full cable with hbo in English (Website hidden by Airbnb) (Also many other languages (Website hidden by Airbnb) Full kitche (Website hidden by Airbnb) Great mirrors! (This is actually my biggest pet peeve, as a lady, when your on vacation and you can’t see your outfit (Website hidden by Airbnb) Friendly and helpful neighbor (Website hidden by Airbnb) Windows slide fully open (Website hidden by Airbnb) Great market on the corner!!!!
Muy lindo departamento con todo equipado. Muy limpio. Tiene una buena ubicacion ya que esta cerca de todo. Muy recomendable.
Lindo apartamento! Igual a las fotos. Excelente ubicación
excelente ubicacion, hermosa vista de puerto madero, recomendadisimo!!!
Notre hotesse nous a tres bien accueillis par l'entremise de collegues sur place à BA. L'appartement était parfait bien que plus éloigné du metro.
Uno de los mejores alojamientos en BS As. Sinceramente muchas gracias.
Excelente recepcion por parte de Anahi. Es un depto muy seguro, comodo, bien equipado,  limpio y  muy bien ubicado en la ciudad. 100 % recomendable. No dudaria en volver a alquilarlo.

Um ótimo espaço para um casal, com ótima vista da Plaza del Congreso, próximo ao Metro Peña, bons restaurantes e padarias ao redor. Um piano excelente e muitos livros para inspirar-se culturalmente. Tivemos o prazer de tocar piano nas nossas folgas dos passeios. A cozinha é pequena e pode-se esquentar uma água para um chá ou fazer um café.  A recepção pela Elo foi excelente.
Buen lugar, excelente ubicación. Todo de acuerdo a lo esperado.

The apartment is modern and comfortable as in the photos. Very nice to live in.

It is right near the Drago train station which can get you into Retiro Mitre in 20 minutes.  You can also walk to Urquiza and get the subway into the center.
By Cabify it is 20 minutes to Palermo.

It is on a busy street, there is car noise until 10:30pm.

The internet is fast.
Me encanto el lugar, la amabilidad de Cecilia excelente, siempre estuvo pendiente de cualquier cosa, la ubicación a mi parecer inmejorable.
El lugar el muy lindo, tranquilo y cerca de todo. Los anfitriones siempre estuvieron para lo que necesitábamos. Lugar y anfitrión muy recomendable.

Ralf, Marcello and the rest of the guys in the office were absolutely terrific.  They went out of their way to be helpful, and really helped us get our feet on the ground quickly.  The apartment we stayed in was lovely (Bali), and location was perfect. Also, it was very secure and safe. We recommend this rental highly.
David and Cindy from the U.S.

Wonderfully-appointed apartment in Buenos Aires! Convenient location in Palermo, Lots of markets, cafes, restaurants nearby. The apartment was fresh and clean and does indeed have a wonderful view of the city! Ralf was a pleasure to work with -- he was so understanding when our flight was delayed by 2 hrs (but we had no way of letting him know as we were stuck on the plane) and he was patiently waiting for us without hearing a word from us. Check-in was easy and done by Ralf's colleague -- who was SUPER helpful telling us about the town, showing places on the map, giving us tips, etc about day trips, etc. I actually got sick that 1st morning we arrived, and they brought me an extra blanket to keep me warm! I wouldnt hesitate to book this apt again the next time we are in BsAs.
Excellent accomodation! Pablo was quick to respond to my messages and was happy to accomodate a difficult schedule.

It is in a quiet street in Palermo Hollywood with al the hip restaurants and bars close at hand. I would surely recommend Atempo as a hotel.
El depto de Berl es un espacio amplio y está en una ubicación privilegiada. Tiene todo lo necesario para pasar una buena estancia. Destaco el check in y out que fueron super cómodos para nosotros.

Todo fue absolutamente perfecto.  Excelente ubicación, la vista desde el apartamento es muy buena. María y su madre eran encantadoras y nos dieron muchos consejos para visitar Buenos Aires.  Lo recomiendo altamente!

Great host. Extremely well-communicated on every aspect of the arrangement. Babak also gave great advises on restaurants, cafes and shows etc. the place is in the center of everything , very convenient. Highly recommended.
Raúl fue muy amable y siempre respondió con rapidez las consultas que tuve.

Griselda nos dejó entrar antes de lo establecido y también salir varias horas después! lo que fue muy cómodo para nosotros porque el colectivo lo teníamos a las 17hs y el horario de salida era a las 10am. 
El lugar es super accesible y práctico. Nos quedamos una sola noche para asistir  a una boda en Puerto Madero y estábamos bastante cerca. El departamento está equipado con aire acondicionado, una cocina muy completa y tiene otra cama (además de la matrimonial) con un colchón debajo así que tranquilamente pueden hospedarse 4 personas. No es lujoso pero es cómodo y con una muy buena ubicación. Además Griselda los recibirá con todas las indicaciones para moverse por bs as y hasta la tarjeta sube por si la necesitan!!
Ubicación excepcional. Lindo departamento.
Todo tal cual lo acordado. Buena comunicación y el hospedaje en muy buenas condiciones. Recomendable.
Very nice accommodation. Everything was great. I can recommend it to everyone

Un departamento privado en una ambiente seguro y cerca de todo.  Es como que te reciba en Buenos Aires alguien muy querido de tu familia! Excelente ambiente y muy accesibles para ayudarte en lo que necesites. Definitivamente recomendado!

Incredible location for your stay in BA! Close to Palermo for night life and restaurants but also close to downtown for the sights. Only three small blocks from train station. And the helper, Yoli, is super sweet! We highly recommend. Muchas gracias Guillermo!

A estadia foi maravilhosa em todos os sentidos, localização é perfeita, perto de tudo e bem do ladinho do obelisco. o quarto é lindo, bem arrumado com uma decoração muito bonita e muito aconchegante.  E nossa anfitrião foi excelente,  sempre atenta a nossas dúvidas e sempre disposta a ajudar.

Sebastian is very attentive and often shared advice. The place is located perfectly, in the residential area of Palermo. Everything you need is a couple of steps away nevertheless it's quiet at night. 10-15 min to the subway. Recommended

We had a great stay at this beautiful house! The location is truly superb, exactly where you want to be in Palermo. Daniel and Luz was vet friendly and easy to communicate with. The house is very nice with spacious bedroom and fully equipped kitchen. I would definitely recommend this house for anyone visiting Buenos Aires with a small group of friends or family.

Ignacio durante nuestra estadía fue un excelente anfitrión, desde la llegada hasta la partida siempre atento y pendiente de lo que pudiéramos necesitar. El departamento esta recién pintado,  las sabanas, acolchados, toallas todo nuevo y recién comprado...  además bien amoblado con todo lo necesario para vivir, cocinar, etc...  durante varios días... impecable todo. Nos recibió hasta con regalos de bienvenida... un capo!!! Además el depto. esta tal cual muestra las fotos. La ubicación es excelente y segura. Definitivamente 100% recomendable. Cuando volvamos a Buenos Aires haremos la misma elección sin dudarlo.
Clean, reasonable price and great location. Mario is a wonderful host. Best stay in buenos Aires!

Apartamento amplo, bem conservado, com ótima localização, próximo a restaurantes, supermercado, farmácia e alguns lugares turísticos, como por exemplo o jardim japonês. Uma ótima opção para quem viagem em em família ou grupos de várias pessoas.
A descrição dos utensílios disponíveis no apartamento precisa ser atualizada, pois algumas coisas já foram substituídas ou retiradas, como a máquina de lavar e secar que foi substituída por uma máquina convencional; a lava louças que não funciona; o aspirador de pó que não está disponível; a hidromassagem da jacuzzi que não funciona. No anúncio dizia que possuía serviço de limpeza gratuito (mediante pedido). Porém quando perguntamos a Tia do anfitrião (que foi quem nos recebeu) disse que não oferecia esse serviço gratuito. 
O quarto 4 (dependência de empregada) é bem pequeno, o colchão é menor do que a cama, fica longe dos outros quartos e o roupeiro é utilizado como depósito de materiais pelo anfitrião.
El departamento se encuentra en una muy buena ubicación. Cuenta con una linda pileta y seguridad. Blas fue muy amable con nosotros en todo momento. Recomendable!
Stylish, modern apartment in Buenos Aires. Had all essentials for a few days stay! And access to the pool thrown in! Great location in Palermo... walking distance to plenty of bars and restaurants!

Sólo para quienes estén dispuesto a una experiencia excelente: el departamento de Fernando es tal cual se ve en las imágenes, además él estuvo dispuesto en todo momento a facilitar ayuda y comodidades. Por otro lado, la ubicación es ideal para desenvolverse fácilmente: en el centro de zona turística, recreativa y con muchos bares, restó y cervecerías que están disponibles las 24h. A 5 cuadras de subtes y ubicación directa hacia las principales avenidas.  Una opción perfecta para ocasiones de trabajo y ocio.

El departamento es genial, tiene todo lo necesario. Es cómodo , lindo y limpio. Cerca de muchos puntos de interés, de plaza Armenia , donde hay muy lindos lugares para comer y muchos negocios. 100 por ciento recomendable.
Silvana una excelente anfitriona.

Excelente departamento! 
 Limpio, cómodo y con muy buena ubicación.   Todo 10 puntos.
  Muchas gracias, Hernan y Jimena!

See English version above, hay versión en Español abajo!! 
With this place you found a true treasure!! Excellent located at the corner of Bartolome Mitre and Pringles you are in the heart of Almagro which is wonderful especially for Tango dancers like me. (Many milongas around the corner). Claudia's home is bright, spacious, filled with a lot of beautiful plants. She has a decent style and I felt very comfortable. She also has a cat and a turtle which likes to walk around and is super cute (she likes to eat melon!). Caudia shared everything with me, she invited me to take any food or drink that I like. I also could wash my laundry here. Seriously, there would not be any wish that she woud leave unfulfilled. She is always up for a chat and also gives private space when you need it. I could not recommend this place high enough and a wish her all the best from the bottom of my heart. Claudia is a kind, thoughtful and helpful host who will make your stay in Buenos Aires wonderful, because you will have the best homebase.

ESPANOL:
¡Con este lugar encontraste un verdadero tesoro! Excelente ubicado en la esquina de Bartolomé Mitre y Pringles, estás en el corazón de Almagro, que es maravilloso especialmente para bailarines de tango como yo. Host: Ezequiel is AWESOME. He is responsive and he made me feel very welcome. While check in, he explained everything I need to know during my trip.
Apartment: I really loved it and i don't think the picture are doing justice to it. The bed is super comfy. The internet is fast. It's very clean and cosy. The building is new and modern and it has a 24/7 doorman.

Excelentes anfitriones Marisa y Jorge! Están en cada detalle para una estadía cómoda cómo ser mapas para una mejor ubicación, café/te/mate para desayunar. El dpto es amplio y luminoso, wifi funciona perfecto! Estuvimos como en casa! Gracias! Volveremos!
Excelente alojamiento, buena ubicación y conectividad.
Depto con muy buena ubicación

Nice place with good location and a cute balcony. As most apartments in Buenos Aires, it's a bit old, but everything works perfectly, and the balcony is beauty. Silvia helped with everything we needed very quickly. Just be aware that if your planning on sending heavy files trough internet, it's not fast enough.

I was really happy to stay at Claudia's Apartment again! It is well located in the heart of Palermo Soho, equipped with all you need, clean, cosy and fast Wifi! Claudia is always very helpful and made my stay unforgettable. Thank you very much.
Hola la ubicación es muy buena y siempre resolvieron lo que les pedí

Tomas apartment was nice, well located. The pool is shared with the all building and on the 9th floor, so we were a bit disappointed. However I would recommend the place and Tomas was very helpful ! Cheers

Excelente el departamento, tanto por la ubicacion, como por el confort, limpieza y seguridad. Es tal cual como muestra el anuncio, y Maria Eugenia se comporto de manera excelente con nosotros; respondio nuestras llamadas, soluciono incovenientes,  nos dio recomendaciones acerca de lugares a visitar y tomamos un servicio adicional que ofrece; el cual fue excelente en cuanto a puntualidad y confort. Super recomendable y voleria a reservar en un proximo viaje!!

El apartamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, la ubicación inmejorable sin duda volveríamos. Loli y Lucas fueron excelentes anfitriones y muy considerados con nuestras necesidades. En resumen un apartamento de ensueño altamente recomendable!
Muy buena ubicación. Limpieza.

Appartment is in great location and with awesome views, note it was 39th floor so if you don’t like heights avoid it. The bedroom has 180 deg views due to 2 walls being floor to ceiling glass. This appartment needs to be finished off with the things you would expect of such a great place. For a start the safe needs securing as having sitting on a shelf not bolted down renders it useless. Improve the kitchen with a few more items such as cereal bowls, tea towels to dry dishes, toaster and kettle rather than having to boil water on stove top. The apartment is modern, very comfortable and in the centre of BA.

Muy buena anfitriona, todo impecable, igual a las fotos. Ofrece lo básico para la cocina y el baño. El departamento esta bien ubicado, subte, buses, restaurantes, teatros, ...a metros.  Muchas gracias Karina por tu atención!

Lo que se ofrece en la página está presente, el alojamiento comodisimo, la ubicación excelente ( sea cual sea tu motivo de estadía, es accesible a todas partes), Mariana responde a cada consulta con prontitud, es muy amable.

My boyfriend checked in to the apartment first and I arrived later, but all went well, check in was easy and as scheduled. I stayed for approximately 1 month in this apartment and it was great. The building itself was quiet. Sigi and her mom were both easily accessible and responded to messages very quickly whenever needed to answer questions. The building manager was also incredibly friendly and helpful with anything we needed.

The apartment had everything we needed, including sheets / towels, a comfortable bed, enough space for two people, television and cable and the wifi worked well. The kitchen was sufficiently equipped with most things you would need for a short stay (Pots / pans / plates / utensils - stove top and oven). Most people on a short stay eat out a lot, but it was certainly equipped well enough to cook meals on your own if you wanted. 

The apartment is clean and well taken care of.

Accessible by buses 59 & 64 almost to your doorstep. A range of other buses available within two streets. About a 45 - 60 minute walk to Plaza Italia in Palermo. Approximately $100 - $120 Pesos taxi ride to San Telmo or a 1 hour bus ride depending on the time of day.

The area itself was calm, quiet and safe. I spent a lot of time working on my computer from cafes in the area and walking around by myself with no issues. Although, all of the buildings are secure, many have security guards or doormen and often stores are locked in the evening, only allowing entrance to those who they approve. It appeared to be for a precaution and I never saw any difficulties.

There are several small grocery stores within two minutes walk. Lots of nice cafes ... give Tienda de Cafe a try on Frederico Lacrose (Tibia de lomo ensalada. YUM!) or Pit Deli on Soldado de la Independencia. Both were lovely spots to eat and / or work for a few hours. Oh yes, and Mamie bakery also on Soldado de la Independencia for yummy pastries.

Don't expect anything for night life in the immediate vicinity, but the heart of Palermo is easily accessible by bus or a $50 - $60 peso taxi. Palermo Hollywood lights up the night with lots of trendy restaurants and cafes Thursday through Saturday.

Most things are closed down on Sunday, so make sure you do any errands on weekdays.

Lots of green space and parks near by and a Freddo Ice Cream Cafe within two blocks.

Overall, the apartment and location were great for a laid back, quiet stay. If you are looking to be in the heart of the nightlife, this isn't the best choice, but if you like privacy and a quiet more residential area, you'll be very happy here.

I had a lovely stay.
es un departamento amplio y tiene buena iluminacio,  volvería siempre.
Cozy duplex really good located, easy access and close to restaurants and pubs. The neighbourhood is amazing.

The staying at Ignacio's `lace was wonderfull!
He is very friendly and helpfull and very quickly, feeling like at home...
I definitely recommend this place!!!
Excelente lugar, atención y comodidad excepcional, muy recomendado/amazing place , exceptional customer service and very comfortable, highly recommended.
genial!!! ubicación excelente,tranquilidad,muy cómodo y lindo depto!!! Las chicas son muy atentas!!

One of the nicest apartments I’ve stayed in in Buenos Aires. Very beautiful, well appointed, and an extremely comfy bed. Great balcony too with chairs to enjoy the bottle of wine flor y Gus left for us. A really nice touch! Couldn’t be better located either, for sure the best part of the city to stay in. Loved it!
Espacio bastante limpio y amplio. Las anfitrionas son muy atenciosas y contestan siempre muy pronto. Buena ubicacion sobretodo a los que les gustan salir a la noche para bares y discos.

Africa was super clear and quick on indications relating to check in and check out. She is super available to help and super reliable. The place is in a very nice area of Palermo and the balcony has a nice view over the neighborhood . Highly recommended !

Great place! Such a lovely host, so welcoming & gave us great tips for exploring the city. Very communicative on Whatsapp too which was nice, arranging check in time, helping us in getting from the airport etc . Well located, lovely space, clean etc. Highly recommended

Cameron's apartment is great. Pretty much the best location in Palermo Soho - lovely residential street about 3 blocks from the denser bustle, all shops you need in the immediate area (restaurants/bakeries/groceries, etc), an easy walk to parks and Botanic Gardens.  The building is terrific - modern, very secure, washers and dryers on site. Oct too chilly for swimming, but the landscaped interior garden is lovely for a stroll or admiring from the apt balcony. Apt is spacious and functional. Very quiet for 6 nights out of 8 - on 2 we got some noise from the upstairs neighbors, but nothing bad. Cameron was terrific - responded instantly to messages, flexible with check-in and departure.  Highly recommended.

El alojamiento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos esta muy bien ubicado y todo se encuentra limpio y ordenado, la única contra es el (Website hidden by Airbnb) calle es muy transitada y la ventana a mi entender no tiene la suficiente aislacion .Por el resto todo muy bien .

El piso era muy confortable  limpio 
Cristian era muy simpatico y disponible con nosotros 
La accommodation era bien decorada y grande y bien situada para visitar

Não conheci Graciela pessoalmente, mas me deu todo suporte por aqui... Respondeu todas as nossas dúvidas e passou várias dicas, enfim, foi muito prestativa!! Mesmo sendo minha primeira viagem a Buenos Aires, me senti completamente segura!! No apartamento fomos recebidos pelo Sr. Sergio e pelo Patricio (porteiro), que é uma figura, muito querido.... Os dois nos auxiliaram muito também.... Quanto ao apartamento, corresponde ao anunciado, instalações muito boas e em local privilegiado! Quanto ao bairro, pelo que ouvi falar, a Recoleta é um dos melhores lugares para se ficar!!

Es un coqueto apartamento con lo necesario para pasar unos días en Buenos Aires. Decorado con gusto y muy acogedor.  La ubicación  es inmejorable . Al lado hay una entrada al subte que se comunica con todas las líneas. Y a dos calles del obelisco  . A metros de la calle LAVALLE y un poquito más de la calle FLORIDA.Lo recomiendo. Maritza es un primor.

We had a WONDERFUL time in Buenos Aires! Jorge and Cynthia are awesome, they provide very detailed information about the city and they answer to all your questions almost immediately!

The apartment is absolutely fantastic, everything is super clean and fully equipped. The place is spoteless, really!
It is really cool to be drinking a beer in the balcony after a long day walking around. And the location is perfect. You can walk around in Palermo, that is a very nice area with lots of restaurants and the metro is just a couple of minutes away.

My recommendation is STAY HERE!!!!

I have left yesterday and I already miss it. :)

We were hosted by Ezequiel who kindly sent us a taxi at the airport when we arrived in Buenos Aires. He provided a lot of advises and tips so we get the best possible experience for our stay in Argentina.
The apartment is clean, comfortable, well located, secured and functional.
We highly recommend the host and this place.
Excelente ubicación, muy recomendable! Mercedes siempre estuvo atenta a las consultas. Los volvería a elegir!

In a great location, surrounded by parks, good restaurant options. The condo is clean and safe, with a huge spacious bedroom that is very comfortable. Highly recommended. Jean Franco is quick to respond, and offers great advice and service during your stay.

El departamento tiene una excelente ubicación, privilegiada.
Es cómodo, tiene dos aires acondicionados, y es espacioso para una o dos personas.
Giorgina es muy amable y da excelentes recomendaciones

Maca is incredibly available, kind and helpful. She let us do an early check-in, and was always available to text or call (using (Hidden by Airbnb) ). 

The place is clean, easy and feels safe, the neighborhood is awesome (it is really noisy in the mornings though) and it's close to lots of great food. It also has a clothes washer which is great. 

I recommended to Maca that she get a folder with all of the info you need to stay there, because for this trip I had to text her every little question I had (like where to take the garbage out, how to do the laundry, how to check out, etc) so hopefully that can be provided for the next guest. 

Definitely recommend this spot.
Nice place!
very nice place for reasonable price
Claudio is an amazing host! Great place, location and comfort!
Excelente la ubicación y la predisposición de Santiago. El depto estaba impecable y cómodo y es más grande de los que muestran las fotos.

O apartamento foi exatamente o que esperava tudo muito limpo as camas são boas estávamos em 3 pessoas que acho que é o número exato para se hospedar .. a anfitriã nos recebeu muito bem e tudo que precisamos ela nos respondia imediatamente.
Super recomendo esse apto! Se um dia voltar a Buenos Aires irei procurar por ele novamente .... e a localização excelente!

Lilian's apartment was very well located and great for a larger group of people. She was very responsive, available and even coordinated to have the apartment cleaned during the stay which was great. I would very much recommend this apartment to this looking for a place to stay in Palermo!
incredible place from which to explore BA. Right on the edge of San Telmo, on a safe street, within walking distance of some very cool restaurants and bars as well as the market. you must stay here

El departamento tiene una ubicación inmejorable! Muy limpio, hermoso edificio y muy buena vista del dpto a la ciudad.  Sólo tuvimos un inconveniente un par de veces con la ducha pero se solucionaba rápido. Estuvimos muy cómodos y nos recibieron y trataron muy bien. Incluso quisimos pasear el ultimo dia y Paula nos permitió dejar las valijas en el departamento. Recomiendo este alojamiento sin dudar!!

Gracias Silvana y Claudia por la hospitalidad
Hermoso departamento en la mejor zona de la ciudad
100 % recomendable

This is a gorgeous apartment, very nicely furnished, with very comfortable bed and soft, quality bedding. Guillermo was very flexible to arrange for our early check in and late check out to accommodate our flights schedules. Both Guillermo and his housekeeper Yoli are very warm hosts, available to help with whatever is needed. Location is great too, easy access to sightseeing and shopping. Highly recommend this apartment and host!!

El departamento está excelentemente ubicado, a metros del parque San Martín. 
Lamentablemente esta es la única cualidad del espacio, que deja mucho que desear. 
Además de configurar un ambiente mínimo (cama + mueble de cocina + baño), es muy caliente y carece de aire acondicionado (tiene un ventilador) y le faltan requisitos minimos de hospitalidad ( no tiene no jabón en el baño, menos champú o un reparador en la cocina o un saquito de té).
Adicionalmente la cama está muy destartalada y muestra hundimientos profundos, lo cual la hacen una tortura para dormir. 
La heladera no funciona correctamente y el refrigerador acumula hielo de meses lo que lo hace imposible de ser usado.
Por último la alfombra está muy deslucida y manchada. 
Realmente no lo recomiendo

Excelente lugar, limpio,cómodo accesible, bien ubicado. 
Nacho su anfitrión una excelente persona, cálido, muy atento, servicial y te apoya en cualquier situación que necesites, te hace sentir bienvenido. recomendable 100%.

The best thing about Luis' place is the space, the apartment is huge! A much welcome change after staying in hotel rooms.  
The place is comfortable and very conveniently located close to shopping and restaurants. There is a lot of street noise that comes into the bedroom in the early hours of the morning. So, if you're not there to party and need a good night's sleep, the couches in the living room make a decent bed (no noise comes into the living room).
Juan was a fantastic help to us when we arrived (even though we spoke very little Spanish) and Luis was always on hand to answer questions. Absolutely wonderful hosts.

Gran estancia en Buenos Aires. La casa es magnífica, testigo vivo del antiguo esplendor de la capital. La localización es muy buena, en una calle tranquila y cerca de todo. Al llegar tuvimos la sensación de que la casa era algo fría, pero gracias a la funda nórdica de la habitación, estuvimos muy a gusto. El trato por parte de los anfitriones Lina y Alex fue muy bueno. ¡Gracias!

We stayed at Griselda's apartment for two nights. It was perfect for two adults -- I slept in the bedroom and my friend slept on the sofa/pull-out bed in the living area. It might be tight with more adults, but certainly doable. Griselda had a personal emergency so she wasn't there when we arrived, but she left the keys and instructions and check-in went very smoothly. The location is very convenient to public transportation (subte right next door) as well as very easy to walk to many areas. From the booking and up until we checked out, Griselda was very prompt in responding to communications. We had a great time!

Stop your search and book this apartment. The location, view, size, amenities and care Ralf and his staff provide will make you feel like royalty. 

Extras: The floors are heated, you get a tour with step by step instructions, restaurant recommendations, a phone number you can call 24/7. I can go on an on but really, if Palermo is where you want to stay (and it is a great neighborhood to stay at), this place will satisfy all your needs. 

Thank you for a memorable stay!
Ótima localização, fácil  check in E comunicação. Quarto arrumado e confortável.
The apartment is great, even better than it looks on the pictures. The hosts very very helpful and kind. I highly recommend this place!
Unfortunately, I had to return home because of a bereavement. Geraldine was very helpful when I needed to leave at short notice. Very nice apartment. Close to all the cafes etc in San Telmo.
Lindo departamento en excelente ubicación! Buena relación precio calidad y la respuesta de Beatriz fue muy rápida. Lo recomiendo!
Amazing place......great terrace with jacuzzi and a BBQ....excellent and clean.....fantastic wifi.....amazing hosts.......we will back!    great location.......loved it!

Super séjour dans la très jolie maison de Leonor située à Palermo Viejo à quelques pas de nombreux bars et restaurants. Avec une grande chambre, un salon charmant et une terrasse privative pour le petit déjeuner, l’habitation offre l’avantage d’une réelle indépendance doublée de l’accueil chaleureux d’un hôte qui a une longue tradition de Bed & Breakfast derrière elle. On se sent tout de suite très bien dans ce cadre privilégié et la piscine au milieu de la verdure est évidement un plus pour une résidence en pleine ville. Un grand merci Leonor pour votre accueil et cet agréable séjour, nous reviendrons sans hésiter!

excelente el departamento, súper cómodo, todo impecable y de buena calidad. Muy buena ubicación, lugar tranquila, lleno de negocios por la zona. El edificio muy tranquilo, sin ruidos. EXCELENTE la atención de Mariano y Sofía, dispuestos, atentos, serviciales, puntuales, correctos, amables. Altamente recomendable el depto.

Agustín was a great host he went beyond the extra mile for having us after a long flight. The apartment is great, amazing location for young people like us, near pubs and restaurants but also from the main city attractions.

I totally recommend this to everyone who’s interested in exploring a young spot in Buenos Aires!
Liliana es una excelente anfitriona. Esta pendiente de la comunicación y de resolver cualquier inconveniente con celeridad. Es muy amable.
todo estuvo muy bien, el departamento es muy comodo y muy espacioso y el trato fue cordial

Mi estadia fue increíble. Los padres de Alejandro son muy amables y te hacen sentir como en casa, siempre atentos y muy cálidos. 
El alojamiento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, en una ubicación ideal. 
Sin dudas volveria!

Elvira é super hospitaleira, é fácil de ver que ela adora receber pessoas e recebe muito bem! localização não podia ser melhor também, do ladinho do metro e tem tudo perto, restaurantes, mercado e é fácil de ir para vários pontos turísticos.

En general un muy buen lugar para hospedar. Diego y Naty fueron muy amables y considerados, incluso me esperaron a que llegara del aeropuerto (que fue tarde por cierto). Los únicos detalles es que hacía mucho calor e hizo falta un ventilador o aire acondicionado, además como sugerencia sería bueno tener internet disponible. Gracias! Lo pasé excelente en Bs As.

Georgina es una magnífica anfitriona que está pendiente de todos los detalles. El apartamento es una maravilla y la ubicación es fantástica porque el sector es el mejor de BsAs y tiene cerca todo lo que se puede necesitar. Espero regresar muy pronto

A Angel é uma pessoa bastante atenciosa, estava nos aguardando, mostrou todo o apartamento e nos orientou sobre o bairro.
Havia na geladeira um garrafa de água mineral e sabonete no banheiro, e tudo limpo.
Excelente localização, está de acordo com as fotos do site, recomendo, excelente estadia.
Great location and very clean flat. Carlos was very easy to deal with and prompt at replying. Would highly recommend

Todo muy bien! El apartamento perfecto, muy bien ubicado, y los servicios tambien.
Muy racomendable!!!

L'appartamento è ben localizzato ,vicino al metro e a servizi di ogni tipo.Gerardo è stato puntuale e gentile. Il palazzo è tranquillo e sicuro.Lo spazio ,ben diviso,è sufficiente per ospitare quattro o cinque persone. Ventilato e luminoso, come nell' annuncio,ma non dipinto di fresco. Ana es un anfitrion excelente! sumamente atenta y con vocación de servicio. Estuvo atenta a todo! gracias Ana!
Excellent emplacement, appartement très lumineux, bien équipé, immeuble gardé et excellent accueil du gardien. Nous étions 3 et avons passé un séjour très agréable.
Todo perfecto, el departamento muy cómodo y en una hermosa ubicación, Héctor muy amable, estuvo en todos los detalles para hacer nuestro hospedaje muy placentero. 100% recomendable.
Very safe place.

El departamento es pequeño pero bastante cómodo y muy bien equipado.
Súper luminoso y la ubicación en nuestro caso fue exactamente la que queríamos.
Agradecemos mucho la hospitalidad de todos los administradores, la cálida recepción y las respuestas inmediatas a todas nuestras consultas.
Muchas gracias y esperamos regresar en nuestra próxima visita a Buenos Aires.
Nos gustó mucho el departamento de Sylvia! Muy bien ubicado para los que quieran un lugar tranquilo y cerca de todas las comodidades :)
Adriana es una persona muy amable y sonriente. Si tiene tiempo, elle tiene muchas cosas de su vida a contar :)

Fantastisk hyggelig lejelighed! Den ligger ikke helt centralt i byen, men meget tæt på den nærmeste metro så man er hurtigt inde i centrum. Kvarteret er dog også hyggeligt og ikke for turistet. Silvia var en virkelig sød og rar vært som fik os til at føle os hjemme og gav os gode tips til området og transport. Vi nød at vi kunne bruge køkkenet og den meget skønne og flotte tagterrasse. Helt klart et besøg værd og vil kun anbefale det!

Marina was an excellent host! She communicated clearly and was accommodating when our ferry arrived later than expected. Her apartment is amazing and was the perfect size for two people traveling together. The area around her apartment was amazing as well--tons of bars, restaurants, and parks nearby. Thanks Marina!
I already read the reviews before I booked and they are exactly as stated from other guests. Great communication, flexible, and always responsive. Thank you for the stay!

A casa é bem localizada, tem fácil acesso a estações de metro e ônibus e supermercados. Agustina é disposta é bem solicita, entretanto tivemos alguns problemas com relação a limpeza da casa e ao funcionamento de alguns eletrodomésticos.
Cercano a todo! subte a 300 metros, su anfitriona siempre atenta a todo

Fernando is a very welcoming host. He helped us with the best way to the apartment from the airport. He wasn't able to receive us, as our flight was delayed, but had one of his neighbours ready with the keys and checked up on us in person after a few days. He is attentive with responses through email and (Hidden by Airbnb) within the hour usually.
The apartment is central with San Telmo around the corner and the city centre and Puerto Madero a 5 min walk. The interior is grand with tall ceilings, windows and doors. The generous bedroom has the only external window, with the living room and entrance hall taking light from the buildings internal courtyard. The kitchen is small but has everything you need. The bathroom compensates for the small kitchen.
I would recommend this for people on medium to long stays, we stayed a month. There is some ambient noise but no more than one would expect in any city (although some of the ambient noise is tango music so maybe one would not expect it in 'any' city) . It is a great place for tourists trying to get the most out of Buenos Aires as it close to buses and the subway. We will definitely return here if our travels take us back to BA.
Lindo departamento. Buena relación precio calidad
Muy confortable. Barrio muytranquilo

El dapartamneto, super bonito, limpio con mucho estilo, todos los servicios, algunos extras que no imagine. Pablo muy atento con cualquier duda para llegar y ubicar el. Está muy bien ubicado y no solo eso un barrio cómodo y tranquilo. Sin duda me hospedaria de nuevo ahí

Great place and location.
Fernando is a fantastic host, thank you for all your help and also for arranging the transfer. The welcome gift was a unexpected surprice that made it all even better.

La experiencia en la casa fue excelente. Cerca de transportes, cerca de lugares de interés, cerca de uno de los parques más lindos de capital federal, cerca de supermercados, dietéticas y restaurants, locales de ropa, en fín de todo.
El loft está cuidado, limpio, es funcional a quien lo habite. Hasta una pareja y 2 hijos podrían dormir cómodos como máximo, sino una pareja está cómoda demás.
Julieta es amable, atenta y responsable, tuve un inconveniente y enseguida se comportó de la mejor manera.

Gaston was a great host. He was friendly and very helpful. His place was clean and in a very convenient location for walking. It was close to a lot of transportation options and amenities on nearby main streets, but off a quiet street which made it a great place to unwind after a long day exploring. I would definitely recommend staying here. I also preferred staying in Recoleta as opposed to the tourist areas like Puerto Madero or microcenter.
Habitaciones super comodas con todos los servicios y con una ubicacion perfecta, la comunicación muy fluida, facil ingreso y egreso. Todo perfecto
Muy lindo lugar, linda zona. Los anfitriones excelentes!!

Bárbara fue una excelente anfitriona, arregló para nosotros transporte desde el aeropuerto, nos facilitó cambio de moneda y nos recibió con una botella de vino!.
Adicionalmente , ante un pedido especial que le hicimos reaccionó en pocas horas dando solución al 100%.

El apartamento y el barrio están bien..
La localización es realmente estratégica, cerca del Microcentro, Puerto Madero, Teatro Colón, Recoleta , etc .. así como del acceso al transporte público.

El minisuper de Carrefour contiguo al edificio, es una ventaja a la hora de proveerse de alimentos, además existen varios restaurantes y panaderías en la manzana.

Excelente ubicación, zona segura y tranquila. Agradable y cálido. Muy buena atención de Sandra. 
Recomendable.

Excelente ubicación. Todo a la mano. Barrio precioso. Con un bello balcón. Camas muy cómodas. Sin TV Ni radio. Que al ir con niños, lo extrañan!!!!
Lo pasamos muy bien. En realidad uno solo va a dormir. Cocina cómoda y bien equipada!!!!
Great location, spotless clean, perfect size for 4 people, plenty of light and very quiet. Very well equipped with appliances.
Nice place. Nice location. Clean room. Funny and kind host. If you stay this place You will get very nice time.

La casita es hermosa, decorada con muy buen gusto y ubicada en un barrio muy tranquilo y seguro. Sofía es una excelente anfitriona, y siempre está atenta a que sus huéspedes estén cómodos. Muchísimas gracias x todo!!!

Super Consigliato!!!
Alejandra mi ha accolto nel suo bellissimo monolocale con una graziosa vetrata, la stanza è molto luminosa e piena di tutti i confort necessari. Ho alloggiato nell'appartamento per più di un mese e ho potuto constatare che lo spazio è nuovissimo, molto ben attrezzato e pieno di tutti i confort necessari per una breve o lunga vacanza. Qualsiasi problema è stato risolto da Alejandra in meno di 24h rendendo il mio soggiorno il migliore possibile. La zona è molto ben serivta da metro, pullman e ci sono diversi supermercati e locali molto vicini.  Sicura e ben sorvegliata non ho avuto nessun problema per l'intera durata del viaggio!
Consigliatissima per chi vuole godere le bellezze della capitale argentina in un posto tranquillo e ben collegato.
Hermoso departamento. Cómodo y súper limpio

Nuestra experiencia en el departamento de Graciela fue muy bueno! Ella es encantadora y amable y el lugar muy cómodo y perfecto para una pareja. Está en una zona con muchos bares y restaurantes. 
La comunicaciones fue sencilla y nos dio consejos de qué hacer en Buenos Aires. Lo recomiendo 100% :)

Gracias por todo Graciela!
Flavia es una persona amable y atenta. El depto superó las expectativas! Muy contento con la estadía!

The apartment is perfect, compact and with a well equipped kitchen. The bed is 5ft/150cm wide and is really comfortable. The aircon works really well and we were so happy to leave our car in the secure carpark while we explored the city. The buses are really easy to use (and directions are on (Hidden by Airbnb) maps) from around the corner into downtown and the metro/underground is only 10 minutes walk in either direction. The pool is great to cool down in after a long day sightseeing. The welcome pack left by Carolina included coffee, tea, bread, eggs, juice, cream cheese and other stuff so we could make breakfast the following day. There was also oil and other condiments in the cupboards so we didn't need to buy them - it has been very rare to find these in other apartments we have stayed in across Central and South America. There is a Carrefor express (mini supermarket) across the road and other larger supermarkets within a 10 minutes walk. There are also many really good restaurants within walking distance. We would stay here again if we were to return to the city and totally recommend it for anyone visiting Buenos Aries and surrounds. Thank you Carolina for your hospitality.
Buena ubicación.

O apartamento de Patricia é ótimo! Possui uma localização perfeita, muito próximo de vários comércios, restaurantes, bares e transporte público. Super arejado e iluminado. Ela foi super atenciosa e nos permitiu sair depois do horário previsto de checkout. Recomendo muito!

Comfortable and clean apartment in a very safe and central area of Buenos Aires. Close to the Retiro railway and bus station. We met Santiago, the owner, the first day and he came to greet us and take the keys the day of our departure. He is a very nice and friendly host. I surely recommend this accommodation.
Excelente localização e ótima acomodação. Lugar seguro e com boas opções de lazer e transporte. Recomendo a todos

Extraordinario lugar. Excelente ubicación. Detalles muy cuidados en el departamento. Muy buena comunicación y la mejor onda Cecilia, gran host. Un lugar para repetir sin dudas. Absolutamente recomendable

The apartment is really cozy and fits the images in the site. It is close to everything and have nice places to eat and visit. I would recommend it for anyone in doubt about where to stay and have all the amenities closer to their place. Thumbs up for the hosts who were really helpful when I needed assistance.

We spent a really nice time in Sonia's place, it is very stylish, cosy and clean. Looks exactly as on photos. Bed was very comfortable. Hola Maxime. Muchas gracias por hospedarnos en tu casa. La ubicación del departamento es muy buena, cerca del subte y de muchas líneas de colectivo. El barrio hermoso. Muy confortable el departamento. Espero que podamos volver a ir. Abrazo!!!
I had an awesome time at Lucas's place, he hast everything sorted out, and the apartment its perfect, I run into some issue and he was kind enough to help. I really recommend staying at his place.
Muy lindo el dpto. La zona es buenisima y Gladys muy atenta con una comunicacion rapida. Muy bueno todo.

Thank you so much for an absolutely wonderful experience. The apartment was darling, just as it looks on the site and the inner courtyard and shared common area were such a wonderful surprise. We loved staying there and really hope we have a chance to again!!!! Thank you so very much, Pam and Ally

Thank you Francisco for your kindest and hospitality. We felt like at home in your lovely place. We are definitely coming back for sure. Súper recomendado, espacio muy completo y con la mejor energia. Excelente ubicación.

El dpto de Isabel es muy cómodo y limpio. Está muy bien ubicado muy cerca del subte. La zona es muy linda . Isabel es muy atenta , responde inmediatamente ante cualquier consulta . Lo pasamos muy bien!!
Dpto recomendable, la anfitriona   hospitalaria y amable, buena ubicación.

Great place for good value. The kitchen has a lot of equipment. Proximity to Dorrego metro (subte) station and Parque Los Andes (playgrounds) are a great plus, especially if you're travelling with children, and shops and groceries are just around the block. Would stay there any time again.

Lovely apartment in a great Recoleta location so conveniently located to the Subway.  It's the people and the little touches that so often make the difference. Your welcoming smiles, a bowl fresh fruit on the table, and a willingness to stay and answer all of lengthy questions about Buenos Aires. You will never know how much we appreciated the late check out.
Cosmopolitan Studio is highly recommended.

Chris & Janet, Bainbridge island, WA, USA

Fantástico departamento en una zona muy cómoda y segura de buenos aires. cerca de shoppings, bares, restaurants, y mercados. No lo conocimos a Joaquín personalmente pero siempre fue muy amable y nos permitió dejar el departamento a las 15hs. la limpieza es excelente y todo en el departamento funciona perfecto. Muy recomendable el café que se encuentra abajo del edificio para desayunar o almorzar (Ol'days Coffee). Los fines de semana puede ser un poco ruidoso por encontrarse en el primer piso del edificio pero nada muy grave. En definitiva es un departamento que recomiendo y al cual volvería sin dudarlo.

Este monoambiente es una pequeña joya dentro de un edificio más bien viejo, ubicado en una calle de poco encanto. Desde la llegada Florencia te hace sentir que has "llegado a casa", en particular con nosotros fue super paciente dado que nuestro vuelo llegó en la madrugada por ende estuvimos haciendo el check-in a una hora poco convencional. A pesar de eso, Florencia nos recibió con una sonrisa y sin prisas nos mostró todo lo que necesitábamos saber del apartamento, incluso se tomo la molestia de darnos recomendaciones para que nuestros días en Buenos Aires sean memorables. 
El espacio es pequeño, sobretodo el baño, pero se entiende que en ciudades grandes esta es una característica común.

This is a lovely apartment and we had a great time there. Set over two floors it has big, luxurious rooms and a delightful kitchen and large balcony upstairs. One of our best Airbnb experiences. Excellent location too

This is a terrific location for spending time in Buenos Aires. My son and I spent five nights in Buenos Aires. The apartment is in a nice neighborhood, a close walk to many good restaurants, the subway and other activities. Alejandra's husband met us for the check-in and was nice to show us around the neighborhood and give us tips for restaurants. Alejandra was also quick to reply to any questions. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Es un lugar místico, la decoración es bastante peculiar con máscaras y sombreros que dan la impresión de estar en Europa (Venecia y España).
Todo excelente! Departamento muy comodo con impecable calefación. Ubicación increible. Federico es muy amable. Es un placer de conoserlo.

The apartment was amazing! We were in Buenos Aires for business and it was a 10 minute walk to Puerto Madero, so close to the San Telmo Market.  It was so clean and the decoration was modern with a vintage taste. Malena made sure that we were comfortable throughout our entire stay from arrival to departure. I highly recommend staying here, I'm definitely coming back!
El departamento muy lindo y cómodo, buena ubicacion y predisposición para todo.
Excelente ubicación, departamento con todos los servicios y muy limpio. Muy buena seguridad las 24 hs. Mejor imposible.
Great location, comfortable bed, and very kind, responsive hosts.  On top of that, it has a great view!  I would love to stay here again.

El señor Hernán es excelente anfitrión es una persona muy atenta estuvo pendiente de mi familia desde que llegamos hasta la salida de su departamento, el departamento es súper cómodo es muy amplio aparte es muy céntrico a los supermercados y líneas de transportes, la zona cuenta con muchas áreas de recreación lo recomiendo 100 %
Comfortable apartment and good location. Very positive experience.

El departamento de Joaquin ha sido exacto como se ve en las fotos. Es un departamento muy bonito, con estilo y excelentes muebles. Es muy amplio para tratarse de un solo ambiente, con una division que separa la zona de la cama con el living y la cocina como si fuera dos ambientes separados.  El balcón y la vista abierta es un gran plus. 
El edificio es moderno, con amenities y en buen estado de conservación y la zona donde se ubica el departamento es perfecta. Lo suficientemente cerca del centro de Buenos Aires, pero en la zona de Recoleta que permite disfrutar de la Buenos Aires más elegante y distinguida con sus restaurantes, cafes y paseos, pero a unos minutos de taxi y también caminando de muchos de los tradicionales lugares para visitar si se esta por turismo. 
El internet por wifi que he usado bastante por mi trabajo funciona excelente, y la televisión por cable cuenta con varios canales y funciona bien. 
Self check in and self check out hace que todo sea muy fácil y el departamento esta equipado para que uno no necesite nada. 
Dos gestos a destacar:  
1. la gentileza de Joaquin de permitirme hacer un early check in atento que mi vuelo aterrizó muy temprano por la mañana. 
2.  Al llegar había una Rhodesia (típica golosina argentina) esperando a mi llegada, que es un pequeño gesto de bienvenida que siempre se valora y produce una sonrisa al arribar a un lugar. 
No se lo pierdan y definitivamente será mi lugar en mi próxima visita a Buenos Aires.
The apartment is better than what it seems by the pictures and the location is unbeatable.

Es un Apartamento de espacio acogedor, muy limpio y con todas las comodidades, agua caliente, TV, Radio y puedes cocinar ya que tiene muchos implementos de cocina (menos licuadora), muy cerca a muchos sitios turisticos y de distracciòn, lo recomiendo 100%; la anfitriona (Yanina) es muy amable y muy diligente a la hora del check in/out, muchas veces sin importar la hora de llegada o salida.
El depto tal cual a las fotos, todo prefecto sin ningun problema. Adriana excelente como anfitriona, siempre atenta y muy amable!!

Jonathan was a fantastic host who ensured my stay in his apartment was as comfortable as possible. He was always available to answer questions and assisted with information about Buenos Aires. The apartment is comfortable and well equipped and an easy location just one block from a subway line.

Great location and apartment. Has everything you need. Close to transportation and us very waksnle.
Our host was very accommodating with check in/out and was very responsive. I would recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again next time we are in Buenos Aires

This place was the nicest of the Airbnb’s we stayed in Buenos Aires! Awesome location in Palermo, walking distance to outstanding shops, markets, and restaurants. The space was updated and clean. We really enjoyed our stay!

Gabriela es atenta y amable. El departamento es impecable. Excelente relación costo-beneficio, espacioso, cómodo, limpio. Nos recibió con jugos y galletitias, agua, elementos básicos de limpieza. Volvería a hospedarme en ese lugar de vuelta!!
Muy  bien ubicado  para todos  aquellos que quieran  estar en enl centro .Muy  bien decorado , buenas  camas,  todo perfecto .Gabriela  muy  amable  y  atenta  .Muy recomendable
Great location, many amenities nearby
Esta muy bien ubivado. A tres cuadras del casco histórico de la ciudad. El dto. no tiene buena vista en sus ventanas pero tiene mucha luz y es moderno y limpio.

Emilio and Flavia were really great hosts, really helpful.Moreover Our host speaks many languages.Casa Kholi is a pleasant place to stay.  Our flat were tiny and cosy.
