Augustin has been an excellent host. He warmly welcomed us at the flat at the proposed time and gave us excellent recommendations to all the various things to do in BA. He was very forthcoming making taxi reservation etc.
The flat is exactly as described and is in a perfect location to explore BA. Public transport is close by and the neighbourhood is full of restaurants, cafes and clubs.
Argentinian nights a long and also loud, which you should not mind coming to an "in-location"

Apartamento luminoso, excelente vista. Ideal para quien viene a descansar. Zona residencial de gran nivel, segura. Muy buen gusto en decoración y disposición del mobiliario. Apto nuevo, prácticamente lo estrenamos.
Lugar muy agradable y acogedor, de buen estilo y en un barrio que está todo pasando. Lo recomendamos totalmente

la suegra de Facundo estuvo esperandonos y presta para darnos indicaciones para disfrutar al máximo el departamento. Estuvieron todo el tiempo en comunicacion con nosotros.FAcundo personalmente nos visitó dos veces.Fueron extremadamente cordiales y abiertos a nuestras necesidades.El lugar estaba justo donde queriamos alojarnos en Buenos Aires y todo fue como el anuncio lo decia. Recomendaria altamente este lugar
Fabiana's place is a lovely, amazing retreat in a quiet, charming part of Buenos Aires. I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a charming, sun-lit, home for their stay in the city.

El departamento es muy espacioso y luminoso. Decoración moderna. Servicios impecables (agua caliente y refrigeración central). Una cama gigante, muy cómoda lo mismo que las almohadas. Todo dentro de un edificio que fue hotel, con sus ascensores antiguos y vitraux alemanes originales. 

La ubicación es inmejorable. A dos cuadras de la Casa Rosada (sede del gobierno nacional) y del barrio de San Telmo, uno de los más antiguos de Buenos Aires. Muy cerca de varias líneas de subterráneo (metro) y de otro barrio, uno de los más nuevos, Puerto Madero. Un agente de policía casi todo el día recorría la cuadra del edificio. 

El anfitrión estuvo siempre muy atento, a través de WA, a nuestras inquietudes, antes y durante la estadía. 

Es el lugar que voy a recomendar a mis amigos para disfrutar de Buenos Aires.

El departamento de Leandro tiene una terraza muy linda. La atención fue muy buena. Hay cosas que mejorar como el WiFi, las goteras y los colchones, pero es una buena opción para conocer Buenos Aires con un costo accesible de hospedaje.

Paul was a very welcoming guy, helping me on the first day to get my electronic metro card, showing me around were to get the things I needed and offered always help. 
The apartment was as discribed and always very clean. However, its style suited the San Telmo district atmosphere well as most things were old fashioned and had not been renovated for a while (e.g. old walls).
The location was perfect, Bus lines and metro stations were within 2 minutes walking distance and also afordable good restaurants were close by. 
In essence, Paul is a very nice guy, the apartment is clean, but old, and the location is close to be perfect.

El depto de Gabriela es muy lindo y cómodo, bien ubicado, estaba muy limpio, y tanto Gabriela como Sol fueron muy amables y contestaron muy rápidamente mis preguntas. También fueron muy flexibles con el check in y el check out. Muy recomendable el departamento!
Stylish place in a great area of Buenos Aires, lots of bars and restaurants on walking distance. Bed and shower were very comfortable.

Muy buena ubicación en un barrio tranquilo pero con muchas posibilidades para comer y visitar los lugares del centro. Hay todo necesario en el departamento y se pueden mejorar la limpieza es un lugar muy cómodo.

Pasé una estadia muy agradable en el departamento de Inés durante unos pocos días. El departamento es amplio, esta bien equipado y en una excelente ubicación. Tuvimos una buena comunicación con Inés y nos facilitó la llegada y salida. Recomiendo.

My wife and I had a great time staying at Barbara's apartment. The apartment is lovely and the location is good for getting into the city centre and for food and drinks.

Todo muy lindo y la ubicación inmejorable.
Gostei muito do apartamento, é espaçoso , aconchegante , bonito. A localização é ótima, próximo a transporte publico, e às avenidas principais.

Amazing location right next to the Sunday market.
La localizacion e espectacular,todo esta cerca.

Pablo is a fantastic host who is easy to reach on (Hidden by Airbnb) or by messages. He was at the apartment several hours ahead of when we landed and the place was clean at arrival. Pablo gave us great recommendations around town and for our trekking in Patagonia. The apartment itself has wifi, air conditioning, fridge, stove, and basic cooking supplies. There's also a cute balcony with a nice view over the Palermo area. Overall, highly recommend Pablo and his apartment!
Excelente Anfitrión... atento a los detalles, y buscando siempre hacerlo sentir a uno mejor que en casa... excelente experiencia
Daniel was a brilliant host met us at the apartment and gave us any information we were after . Great location near bars and restaurants with a shop across the road would happily stay again
A lovely, secure apartment in a great location.
Great value, shows better in real life than in photos, awesome location. Pablo was a pleasure to deal with.

Primero que todo agradecer a Cristina y Ernesto ya que, su alojamiento cumplió todas nuestras expectativas y nos hizo muy cómoda nuestra estadía en Buenos Aires. Esta excelente para quienes quieran estar conectados en Palermo cercano a bares, restaurantes y la ubicación muy segura. Además el edifico muy tranquilo. Lo súper recomendamos para quienes busquen descansar y dormir cómodos ya que cuentan con todos los servicios necesarios para tener una estadía 5 estrellas. Muchas gracias a los host que tuvieron comunicación inmediata y por los tips Ernesto. Saludos.
Absolutely lovely! Nothing to complain about. Great location, super clean, easy check in and check out.
Excelente estadía ! Todo es muy bueno : ubicación , departamento y anfitrión !!!!

El espacio de Leandro es hermoso. Nos recibió muy cálidamente y además nos explicó con detalle todo lo que teníamos a nuestro alcance. Fue la mejor estadía que tuve desde que uso airbnb. Nos encanto haber sido alojados por Leandro, ojalá se repita otra vez.

This is a lovely place in a really central part of San Telmo. It's a large room with double and single beds, really comfy! Bath is amazing and hot water showers make a nice change from some of the other places we've stayed in Argentina. Really clean lovely room, in a great location. Centro is easily walkable from here and so is Recoleta, Palermo is possible if you enjoy long walks!

Emiliano was really helpful on arrival, giving us maps and giving some great recommendations for local food and drink places. He also didn't mind that we arrived early and left later than the normal check in and out times which was so helpful. Gabriel and Alicia live next door, they don't speak English but they're very patient with speaking spanish slowly and working out what I was trying to say in my very poor spanish! They're super helpful and will do anything they can to help. 

I'd definitely recommend this place to anyone going to Buenos Aires for a short or long stay, and we hope to go back there ourselves in the future!
Thanks Emiliano

El lugar es precioso, las piscinas son hermosas y grandes, la cocina muy completa y equipada, tiene café, té, yerba, aceite de girasol y de oliva, salsa de soja.
La ubicación es muy buena, esta cerca del centro pero en un barrio tranquilo y seguro.
Hay tarjetas sube a disposición y consejos turísticos.
María es muy amable y estuvo pendiente de nosotros desde que llegamos.
Great place in a fantastic location. Good value for money. The apartament is nice, with lots of natural light.

Solo palabras de agradecimiento a eduardo y patricia, nos sentimos mejor que en casa. Predispuestos a solucionar y hacernos la estadía mas fácil, lo mejor para ellos y no dejen de consultarlos por posibilidades de alojamiento.
Wonderful views, amazing sunsets, stylish, new appartment, very beautiful. Super host, very kind!

El departamento está muy bien ubicado y equipado con todas las facilidades para tener una estadía agradable y como en casa. La limpieza y el orden es sobresaliente y María Pía siempre estuvo pendiente por nosotros desde el primer momento. Gracias.
Great location, and clean/comfortable apartment! It was very easy to communicate with Iara, and she was flexible with an early check-in!
Excelente atención por parte de Maximiliano. Muy buena ubicación cerca de todo. El apartamento tal cual las fotos y cómodo.

O apartamento é lindo, a luz do sol é maravilhosa, e o bairro é muito bom para conhecer a cidade. O único problema que meu namorado teve foi o barulho do elevador que dava pra ouvir desde dentro da casa. Mas no geral, gostamos.
The apartament is nice, the sunlight is great, and the neighborhood is very good to get to know the city better. The only problem that my boyfriend had was the noise of the elevators, because they are next to the main wall of the apartment. Nontheless, we liked the place.

Apartamento perfeito!! O apartamento é uma graça, exatamente como aparece nas fotos. Fica muito bem localizado, perto do Obelisco, Florida e Casa Rosada. Fomos muito bem recebidos e bem acomodados. Simplesmente perfeito, pretendo voltar novamente. Luke, muito obrigada por tudo!!

Puesto que la persona que enviaba GRABABA el departamento y todo lo que uno tenía ahí VIOLANDO la privacidad de quienes estén alquilando. POR NINGUN MOTIVO RECOMENDARIA EL LUGAR.
2)	Ella nunca tuvo la amabilidad de recibirnos y  la única vez que se contacto fue para llamarnos la atención DE LA PEOR FORMA porque habíamos ocupado TODAS las toallas y la ropa de cama, aun sabiendo que éramos 4 huéspedes. Ella pretendía que ocupáramos una toalla entre 4 personas!!!  (Tengo evidencia de TODO lo que digo, ya que quedó registro en el (Hidden by Airbnb) .)

Excelente, tal cual lo que ofrece. Anfitriòn muy atento al visitante. Gracias Eduardo.

Si estás buscando un lugar para descansar y estar cómodo, sin dudas este departamento tiene  lo que necesitas, los espacios están bien distribuidos, todo es muy lindo, el edición es super tranquilo como si estuvieras sólo.  Todo de primer nivel.

Fabiana and Gerardo were amazing hosts. They were extremely accommodating and went above and beyond for us on many occasions. Gerardo gave us amazing tips on where to eat/what to see in Buenos Aires and met us to exchange dollars into pesos. Fabiana let me know when the buses were on strike, something that saved our entire vacation (and went above and beyond what she needed to do for us). And when I left my favorite hat in the cab we took to the airport, Fabiana was able to retrieve it for me. ALSO, her brother opened up his home to us when we needed a place to stay our last night in BA. I cannot say enough how amazing our experience was because we connected with this beautiful couple. Thank you Fabiana and Gerardo, once again!

El lugar es acorde al precio, bien cuidado y limpio y además está increíblemente bien ubicado. Máxima es amable y se adapta a las necesidades. Viajamos con dos niñas pequeñas y tuvo la amabilidad de extendernos el checkout unas horas más hasta que saliera nuestro avión. Gracias por recibirnos!

Marcos worked with me to make sure I was able to arrive safely and quickly. He is very friendly and hospitable. The location is great and the bedroom is spacious and comfortable. I was very busy during my stay and I could always count on being able to relax and unwind at his place after a long day.
Depto en pleno Palermo-Soho. Lugar limpio y contacto muy simpático! Muchas gracias! la pasamos super!

Absolutely stunning apartment in a central location but a little ways from the hustle and bustle, so nit noisy at all. Only an easy 15 minute walk from everything. Spotless, with everything you need either in the apartment or right at your doorstep.
And Gustavo was an amazing host. Met me at the apartment and gave me plenty of tips on where to eat and anything else I needed. Will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Buenos Aires.
Excelente anfitrionA Julieta una genia !
Una vez más alojé aquí y la estadía fue buena, la ubicación está bien y el barrio es tranquilo.

Falta mantenimiento.
El dpto está ubicado en una de las zonas más lindas de Bs AS, como ya conozco, por eso lo elegí, posee cerca muchas opciones gastronómicas, cafeterías, bares y restos. Martín fue muy amable con los horarios de entrada y salida. No tuve ningún problema. 
Ahora en cuánto al dpto, le falta mantenimiento, principalmente la ropa de cama, las sábanas tenían bolitas, y junto con el acolchado no poseían aromas a limpio. El colchón está bastante hundido. No posee lugar a donde colgar la ropa y solo hay dos perchas. Las cortinas blackout del ventanal están sucias y un poco rotas. La cortina de baño esta vieja. El sillón y almohadones también sucios. Con un poco de inversión mejoraría muchísimo.
Excelente departamento, excelente comunicación con la anfitriona, anfitriona amable, responsable y siempre dispuesta a ayudar. 100% recomendado.  A pasos de subte.
Hermoso departamento,muy buena ubicación en una zona segura.
Estupendo lugar, perfecta ubicación!, óptima comunicación con Roberto desde el momento de la reserva hasta el check out! Nos gustó mucho la decoración y amenities! Volvería sin dudarlo!

Hermosa "casita"!!! La verdad que nos encantó!! Es súper linda!! Estaba impecable el baño!! Que es una cosa que no siempre sucede, y muuy limpia la casa en general también!! La llegada 10 puntos. La atención y predisposición de la anfitriona 1000 puntos!! Una genia total. Tiene un montón de detalles que jamas vi: adaptadores para celulares, zapatillas para corriente, una tarjeta SUBE a disposición de los huéspedes, dos botellones para recargar cerveza, café, azúcar, sal, y otros detalles más que hacen que la estadía sea increíble. De los mejores lugares donde me he hospedado. Gracias!!!!!!

O apartamento é muito amplo e está muito bem localizado em Buenos Aires, mais ou menos entre o centro (Florida) e a Recoleta. É um apartamento antigo, que precisa de uns reparos, mas nada que tenha tirado o seu brilho. Como fomos em 5 casais, os 5 quartos/banheiros (um não era suíte) nos acomodaram muito bem. O 6º quarto não pode ser assim considerado, no meu entender, pois é minúsculo e só tem uma beliche, sem ar condicionado ou qualquer conforto. A cozinha estava completa e a utilizamos muito bem. Infelizmente a internet não funcionou nenhum dia (em que pese a tentativa de Fiorella em resolver - era reveillon e nada mais funcionava em BUE!). Quando chegamos, faltavam toalhas para todos, o que foi logo resolvido. O único problema que enfrentamos foi a falta de luz no primeiro dia, que estava uns 40 graus, mais ou menos. Enquanto Fiorella me mostrou o apartamento, acabou ligando todos os aparelhos de ar condicionado (inclusive o da sala) e a chave geral caiu, mas não aquela que fica dentro do apartamento e, sim, a que fica no apartamento do zelador, que não estava lá (era domingo!). No final da tarde, quando finalmente conseguimos falar com ele, toda a situação foi resolvida e passamos a cuidar para não ligarmos todos os aparelhos ao mesmo tempo. Assim, não tivemos mais nenhum problema. Percebi que há calefação para os dias de inverno e o banho é muito bom, com aquecimento a gás (mas no último dia não aqueceu e fiquei sem saber o que houve. Ainda bem que estava muito calor e a água quente não fez falta!). Vittoria é uma excelente anfitriã, preocupada com a nossa estadia por lá. Por e-mail me repassou diversas informações úteis. Como fomos em grupo para passarmos o reveillon juntos, foi uma excelente opção de hospedagem numa cidade que tanto amo. Obrigada, Vittoria e Fiorella, por tudo! A gente amou ter estado no apartamento e em Buenos Aires!
It is a great location!! Really nice place, with a great host!

Great stay for our first time in Buenos Aires! The location is superb, and you are right next door to 2 famous San Telmo landmarks. We walked to La Boca, Recolata, the main square - getting around was so easy, anywhere a little further we used taxis or Uber. The house itself is also very cool with stylish features. The rooftop BBQ area and pool was a huge bonus. We traveled as two couples and were very comfortable with each having large rooms and a full bathroom. Augustina always responded super quickly and was a reliable host!
Muy bueno. La ubicación es excelente, el transporte también. El lugar es acogedor y silencioso. La respuesta a nuestras solicitudes fueron inmediatas. Fue un lugar perfecto para estudiar y cocinar.

Muy recomendable departamento dos ambientes muy amplios, con todas las comodidades necesarias para hacer que la estadía sea ideal. Ubicado en un lugar muy bueno para acceder a todas las mejores atracciones de la ciudad, algunas se puede ir caminando y a otras en subte que queda a dos cuadras. Zona muy comercial, donde hay varios lugares para comer. A pesar de la zona comercial el depto es muy tranquilo y sin ruidos, lo que permite un buen descanso. Seguramente volveré!

Emma nos atendió super bien, nos dio respuesta inmediata siempre, nos ayudó con el tema del transporte público, la entrega de la llave fue super fácil. El lugar estaba justo para donde necesitábamos ir y tiene un Lucciano cerquita para empacharse de helados jaja
Excelente apartamento. Amplio y muy buena ubicación

Encantados por el servicio y atención. La comunicación constante nos hizo sentir muy bien acompañados.  La flexibilidad con el chekin y checkout es destacable, lugar seguro, tranquilo y bien equipado. Cerca de todo lo necesario para moverse, comer y comprar.  Sin duda volvería a ese dpto.

Franco es un excelente anfitrión. Muy acogedor, amable, detallista y responsable. Siempre disponible para atendernos ante cualquier consulta o eventualidad. Su apartamento es céntrico y está bien cuidado. La proporción costo-beneficio es excelente. Definitivamente recomendado.
Nice, clean apartment in a good location near to the subway and the obelisco.

EXCELENTE UBICACION ,BARRIO MUY TRANQUILO EXCELENTE LIMPIEZA Y RECIBIMIENTO EN EL LUGAR Y DE MARCELA , SIEMPRE DISPUESTA A NUESTRAS NECESIDADES E INQUIETUDES .MUY RECOMENDABLE, EL DEPTO CUENTA CON TODO LO NECESARIO .
Manuela es muy amable y atenta en la recepción y estadía . Siempre se preocupó que estuviera todo funcionando e impecable .
It was really nice. Everything was very clean. Good locate. I loved here!
Departamento muy recomendable, muy prolijo, cerca de todo, fran nos recibió de 10!!  Volveremos a optar por este depto en un futuro cercano!! Graciass!!!

The place was accurate and very affordable. Great location! Teo blocks from famous San Telmo's Sunday street fair and Dorrego Square. Three blocks from Puerto Madero. Know that there is no wifi. I overlooked this viewing various homes in BsAs and assumed they all had it. Other that, great communication and great deal.
Andrea es una anfitriona muy amable. Con una flexibilidad en el horario de ingreso y egreso, lo que permite realizar viajes por estudios.

Los anfitriones unos crás! Tuve varias situaciones unas por responsabilidad y necesidad de mi parte y otras por problemas con el apto y siempre respondieron de la mejor manera. Apto muy recomendable y perfectamente equipado.
Gracias!

We really recommend the apartment so confortable.  The neighborhood is very nice and easy to arrive, also Guido was so kind.  Thanks so much. 
On est passé un très bon séjour. L'appartement est très confortable. Et le quartier est joli et facile pour y arriver. En plus, Guido était super sympa. Merci beaucoup !
Estuvimos muy cómodos en el departamento, en un barrio lindo y fácil para llegar, limpio y bien equipado. Guido fue muy muy simpático. Muchas gracias!

Tomás es una persona muy amable y atenta, el departamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotografías, muy limpio y con las comodidades necesarias. El barrio es muy bonito, algo alejado pero accesible al trasporte.
Me encantó el lugar, cerca de todo, muy conectado. Seguro, tranquilo. Para volver! Muy recomendable

I loved staying at Ana’s apartment and it exceeded all expectations.  Firstly, Ana is kind, fun and generous.  She was flexible with check in and check out.  The room is essentially a private apartment, super quiet with own bathroom and small kitchen.  My only regret is that I didn’t stay longer.  Location is superb for all that Palermo has to offer.  Gracias!

This place is great: you are near great restaurants and bars in the Palermo neighborhood, and also you are 1 block away from the buses to go around Buenos Aires; the building has security, and also it has washer and dryer in case it is needed - I would stay here again when in Buenos Aires.
Great location very easy to move around the city.
El lugar impecable, ubicación mejor aún. 100% recomendable. Adriana una excelente anfitriona!!!
Todo Estuvo de Acuerdo a lo publicado y ofrecido, Sol y Antonio muy amables y serviciales, el depto es lindo y muy funcional. El Barrio tranquilo, cerca de todo, Gracias a los dos.
Ubicación excelente

Si buscas buena atención, la mejor ubicación y limpieza elegí este departamento.
Todo eso más el trato de Pablo hacen de tu estancia un placer.
Lo mejor.
Ubicación excelente, alojamiento práctico.
Excelente monoambiente!. Todo sumamente limpio. Muchos detalles. Lo recomiendo!. Volveria a hospedarme sin dudarlo.
Excelente host, muy amable. El departamento estaba muy limpio y ordenado. Volvería a ir definitivamente

Valeria was an excellent host- was approachable and welcoming but also willing to give guests space if that's what they preferred.  We loved her apartment!  It was perfect for 2 people and very comfortable and clean.  Palermo Hollywood is a lovely neighborhood--you MUST go to Las Cabras (cheap Argentine steakhouse 5 blocks away) if you stay with her! We wished we had more days there.  Thank you, Valeria!
Mariano is very nice and hospitable. He waited for us in front of the door and was very flexible making check in and check out. I recommend this host for everyone :)
La ubicación es en la mejor zona de   Buenos Aires y el departamento en si es impecable..todo de calidad toallas, cubiertos, cama . Excelente estadía pase

El alojamiento es tal cual se publica. La cama es amplia, cómoda. La pieza de por sí es muy grande, con ventanales, aire acondicionado y ventilador de techo. La cocina es nueva y se podían utilizar todos los artefactos sin problemas. Mi estancia fue muy agradable. Como está cerca del subte, moverse es muy sencillo. La pasé increíble!
Pretty awesome place with a nice bathtub on the roof. Great locality to be in
Very nice experience staying at Gonzalo's place: super well located, he was very proactive and helping, and the apartment is great! Highly recommend!
Muy conformes! Excelente ubicación y Mariana muy atenta siempre! Muy buena anfitriona, gracias y hasta la próxima

Excelente la habitación que nos ofreció Elena; espaciosa con mucha luz, impecable, la dercoración es genial; la cocina muy completa y el hecho de andar por los espacios comunues y habitación te da esa sensación de estar en una casa antigua del Buenos Aires. El trato excelente, entramos Elena nos dió la llave de la casa y habitación y listo; como en nuestra casa. Encantados de estar acá :)
Excelente lugar, muy recomendable, el ambiente es increíble. Gabriel es muy amable, y te hacen sentir como en casa.

Inés es muy atenta y considerada. El cuarto es sólo para una persona, está muy bien. Cuenta con Smart TV para usar, por ejemplo, YouTube y Netflix (con tu cuenta). Tiene aire acondicionado y WiFi, toalla, shampoo...
Me gustó mucho. Volveré.
El departamento tiene una ubicación excepcional y es una zona segura; cómodo y limpio! La comunicación con los anfitriones fue excelente! Recomiendo el departamento y sin duda volvería!
El dpto muy cómodo y de buena ubicación. Recomendable!

If you are looking for a place to stay in Palermo and your dates are available for this apartment, STOP LOOKING. You have found your spot. 

This apartment is the best of all worlds. It is right in the heart of the hippest neighborhood (kind of Brooklyn-y, in the best sense) with seemingly endless options for great places to eat (and shop, if that's your thing) and go out at night, but it is in the back of the building, so it is just beautifully quiet. You wake up in the morning looking at trees and listening to the chirping of birds. It's so peaceful.

And honestly, I walked every inch of the neighborhood multiple times, and at night I was so thankful that I didn't end up in an apartment with a balcony that looked out onto the street. I can't imagine how loud it is to be in one on the weekends when the nightlife really turns on. 

It is adorable, very clean, and everything in the kitchen is new. I work online and need dependable Internet to do my job on the road. I stayed there for 2.5 weeks and had no problems getting everything I needed to get done - including conducting multiple meetings on (Hidden by Airbnb) that would have been a disaster with a bad connection. 

And Walter and Tea really are as fantastic as everyone says they are. Tea sent me messages any time she heard of something cool going on in the neighborhood that I might like to check out. I'm celiac and I found a basket of gluten free cookies and pasta and a bottle of wine waiting for me when I checked in, plus a flyer for a gluten-free shop to get more things, if I needed. (There is a fantastic all-gluten-free restaurant just a few blocks away where you can eat bread and tarts and empanadas to your heart's delight, if you have gluten issues -- (Hidden by Airbnb) map search for "sin taxis." Also, if you like burgers, the Burger Joint is amazing, and the boys at the counter are really nice about giving you your burger "sin pan." And Ninina around the corner is a great cafe with delicious salads -- and my friend says amazing organic bread, if you can eat it.)

Just perfect. Trust me and all the people who've left reviews below me here. You can't find better.
Apartamento aconchegante, limpo e ótima localidade. Voltaria sem dúvidas!

Apartamento extremamente limpo, aconchegante, bem iluminado e bem localizado. Nos sentimos em casa. O Patricio é muito cuidadoso. No apto havia mapas, cartão de metrô, café, água mineral, suco e outros mimos que fazem diferença pra quem vem de longe. Ele também nos buscou no aeroporto. Quando pudermos voltar a Buenos Aires, certamente ficaremos lá novamente!
¡ Excelente ubicación, Inmejorable atención, servicio y disponibilidad. Altamente recomendable, Gracias!

Nice stay with a large room. If you like cats and dogs this place is fantastic. The dog likes all the attention he can get and one of the cats too. The hostess is really friendly and although our spanish isn't great and we may not have understood everything it was nice talking to her. My GF thought the cutlery want as clean as she liked, but if you (I didn't) mind cleaning it before use you're fine.
Buena ubicación, persona amable, buen lugar para 2 personas
Super accueil, les photos sont bien représentatives de l'appartement. Camila est aux petits soins. Nous recommandons chaudement.

Excelente ubicación con muchas alternativas de gastronomía bares etc cerca de transportes públicos. Excelente terraza con vista panorámica. Muy buena comunicación para el checkin/ out y durante la estadía. Sin dudas volvería a alojarme
La mejor ubicación de Buenos Aires
El lugar práctico y cómodo para alojarse, con todas las comodidades necesarias para pasar la estadía. El anfitrión fue muy amable y flexible.

Eugenia was great to us, she gave us all support we needed. The appartment is really great. It is near to many nice pubs and restaurants, the address is easy to find and it's also near to the subway station in one of the main avenues in BA. I really recommend!
La casita de Libertad es re lindo, llena de luz y plantas. Un lugar tranquilo con mucho espacio. Estuvimos muy cómodos y Libertad tuvo flexibilidad para la estadía.
We found this Airbnb to be in a great location which allowed us to walk everywhere. Albana apartment provides us with most of the things we needed. Thank you.
Was a great spot, very good location and was easy to communicate with Albana. Thanks for having us!
Excelente nos encanto. muy buena la atencion y el depto. muy espacioso.
Mariana y Luis son muy buenos anfitriones, muy atentos. El departamento es comodo y la ubicacion optima!

El departamento es maravilloso, todo muy lindo, limpio, estiloso y cómodo. Tiene hasta una terracita súper acogedora y bonita. Es mejor de lo que se puede apreciar en fotos.
La ubicación también es muy buena, está cerca de todo, es muy tranquilo y hay restaurantes, bares, supermercados, kioskos, parques, todo cerca. Y la anfitriona Ivanna es muy preocupada y detallista.
Así que estamos super felices de habernos quedado en su departamento, y lo súper recomendamos.

Hospedaje y atención perfecta, vuelvo con ellos si o si.
Ni lo duden en alojar en este departamento, ubicación inmejorable.
A really nice listing in a great location.
Super bien ubicado!!! Limpio, seguridad 24 hs, muy buena comunicación!!!
Excelente ubicación y excelente relación precio calidad!
Monoambiente amplio, limpio y muy iluminado. Buena ubicación. Excelentes anfitriones

Antes que el lugar, su hospitalidad es hermosa, Marilu te hace sentir como si estuvieras en tu casa, en familia, es muy amable y generosa. El lugar está impecable , ideal para descansar bien y estar tranquilo. Más que recomendado.
Muy buena ubicación y predisposición del anfitrión. Excelente todo

Excelente lugar, muy bien acondicionado, las habitaciones muy cómodas; a pesar que es un barrio con vida nocturna no sentimos tanto el ruido de la calle; en dos de las 4 habitaciones incluso había un silencio increíble; los aires acondicionados funcionaban como cañón :) y las camas eran muy cómodas, mis hijos disfrutaron la tele por cable (hay 4, una en cada habitación) y el jacuzzi del 3 piso es un sueño; utilizamos el quincho para hacer asados varias veces y la terraza es maravillosa.

En definitiva fue una excelente experiencia y Augusto fue un host insuperable, 10 puntos.

Excelente ,amable y atenta atención de los dos, todo tal cual lo ve uno en las fotos. Limpio y ubicado cerca de todo lo que uno puede necesitar !  Toda la ropa blanca y demás cosas en cantidades más que suficientes para varios dias. Hizo de que nuestra estadía fuera placentera ...muy recomendable

I recommend Carla's apartment to anyone wishing to stay in one of Buenos Aires' beautiful neighborhoods, and in an apartment on a tree-lined street, just one block from the metro and in close proximity to shopping, cafes and parks. Carla was most helpful  and the apartment is comfortable and quiet.

El depto es impecable , es la segunda ves que me alojo ahí, nos recibieron muy bien , fueron muy atentos , la ubicación es muy buena y está cerca de muchos locales de compra , bares , restaurantes, todo muy bueno !
La casa è completa di tutto quello che possa servirti in una vacanza. Una bella  vista , un'appartamento luminoso e soleggiato. Consigliatissimo senza dubbio.

Impecable departamento, lo volvería a buscar sin dudas.
Pedro fue muy atento.
Ubicación excelente!!!!

Screaming babies, dirt, dishonest communication and I am not happy. When I arrived I had to dust out the closet which was pretty dirty. The floor also hadn’t been cleaned in a while and my feet were black after walking around for a while. I would open the door when it was cool enough outside to get some fresh air because of the smell. It wasn’t extremely strong but was noticeable when entering the room. When I mentioned the dirty floor they did come and clean it. The smell never went away though. The toilet lid kept falling off. Not a big deal but a little annoying. If you like to do any cooking this is not the place for you. Not much for cooking pans and utensils as there was one knife to cut food and a can opener. The only teflon pan had seen better days and there was no lid that fit it which means you would get a ton of spray coming from the pan. There were no steak knives. The baby upstairs made a fair amount of screaming but the noise was mostly in the day time so didn't keep me up. It would have been nice to have salt and pepper and a few basis spices, wrap for preserving food or a few food preserving containers. I have taken care of about 10 properties over the past few years and wouldn't ever leave a unit like this. For communication I am giving 3 stars for a few reasons. I was told that this place was close to the school I was going to be going to. I gave Austin the address and he said the metro is 1.5 blocks away (true) and it would be fast to get there. (false) It took me 30-35 mins of walking as fast as possible through all check points and transfer of trains (which meant squeezing into the metro because the metro is so full in the morning. Sometimes I would have to wait for the next train because the first one coming by was too full. The trains are full from 7:30-9:30 and 5-7. I could skip one of the transfers and walk which was a few mins slower and I opted for this most mornings as I didn't enjoy squeezing into a crowded train. For value I give it 2 stars because I asked Austin if I could check out early since the commute was quite stressful and a couple other things. I wasn't happy about being told the commute was short and easy. I actually had to leave 40 mins ahead of the school start because of the timing of the trains. I said I wouldn't leave a review even though there were other things as well if he would charge me 1/4 of the months stay which I booked. He instead charged me for about 2 weeks and said this is how Airbnb calculates it. I have 10 properties on Airbnb and you have...
Todo genial. Súper recomendable. Excelente ubicación

Matias told me I was his first Airbnb guest, and I felt honored. But his personality gave me the feeling of a perfect host with experience helping others to feel comfortable. We coordinated my arrival and he was waiting for me easy to access. He helped me unload my motorcycle and showed me the ins and outs of his apartment building. Waiting in my room was a bowl of chocolate and walnuts. This I must say was an unexpected but welcome small touch that made me realize Matias was glad I was there. I need to swim for my exercise and there was a pool right across the street. It was worth the cost. Also Palermo is a very social neighborhood with a lot of activity such as restaurants, shopping and parking garages. Matias' apartment is the 5th floor with and elevator. I liked this elevation because of the wonderful breezes and I was above all the activity where I could observe but not feel overwhelmed. A perfect location.
Departamento super recomendable, Jorge muy amable

El departamento tiene todo lo necesario para que la estadía sea perfecta. Tiene cafetera, tostadora, microondas, pava eléctrica y demás. La ubicación es perfecta, y Dafna siempre está disponible AL INSTANTE, resolviendo todo. La zona es muy tranquila. Volvería, y tal vez lo haga.
Es un sitio agradable, muy equipada y cerca a muchos sitios turísticos, con acceso a mercados y zona muy tranquila y segura.
El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos. La ubicación es privilegiada, tenés todo cerca y el barrio es tranquilo. Diego fue muy atento.
Muy lindo departamento, todo muy cuidado y con todas las comodidades , volvería a hospedarme otra vez. El anfitrión muy atento a todo y muy amable. Muy linda zona , recomendable.
Es un muy buen departamento, un barrio muy tranquilo, igual a las fotos, todo muy limpio y cómodo para una estancia.
Es la segunda vez que me alojo con María. Buena ubicación, departamento cómodo y María es una excelente anfitriona. Lo recomiendo!

I lived with Silvia for 3 months and it was great! It felt like coming home and spending time with your family. 
Her place is in a very safe, calm and beautiful neighborhood. Everything you might need (supermarket, restaurants, public transportation, pharmacy, and so on) are close by. (By "close by" I mean not more than 4-5 blocks) 
The apartment is very clean, comfortable and has a breath-taking view you really want to wake up to! Good to know: Every Tuesday comes a cleaning lady who also changes the bed every time. In the dining and living room is enough space for everyone! Sometimes Silvia and I had breakfast and diner together and enjoyed the company! In the kitchen is also everything you might need and there is enough space for your food (in the cupboard and the refrigerator).
Silvia  is the best person I could wish for during my stay in Buenos Aires!! She helped me whenever I needed her and I knew I can trust her! For example, I had a very bad cold and I did not speak Spanish very well, so she went with me to the best doctor, translated and helped me a lot!  After that, she made me a freshly pressed orange juice every morning until the end of my trip! Even my mom does not do that!  All in all, we spent a lot of time laughing and talking together, but every each of us also had her own private space. It was perfectly balanced! Now I am happy and thankful to call her my friend! 
I think living with Silvia and at her place is probably the main reason why I enjoyed Buenos Aires sooooo much!

El departamento es como e ve en las fotos.
La ubicación es muy buena. 
El anfitrión  fue muy amable y atento y nos ayudó mucho.

Josefina tiene una casa preciosa,  muy amplia, 
 con estilo y muy bien cuidada.  El trato fue súper amable.Tuve una  estadía excelente. Cuando vuelva a buenos aires trataré de volver a su casa. La recomiendo completamente

We had a very early flight and Santi was there at the apartment at 6.30am in  the morning to welcome us and show us all the ins and outs of the apartment. He was just a phone call away if we had any more questions. It was just like the photos, even better as we didn't realise how nice and roomy it was, with a whole extra bedroom to put our packs in. The bed was big and comfy, and everything was comfortable and clean and we were able to cook our meals , listen to music and watch DVDs for the lazy nights when we didn't feel like going out. It was great to be able to do our laundry as well. 
I think Palermo is one of the best places to stay, and Santi's apartment on the top floor was nice and close to everything, but not noisy. We went out to see some music a couple of nights and felt completely safe walking home afterwards.

Very nice place exactly like on the listing. Perfect area, super quiet and waking distance from the booming center of soho.
Unfortunately i could stay one one night because the AC was not working and it was definitely too hot. But Joaquin was very flexible and offered me another accommodation. Top service!

Sehr gute Lage, zentral und sicher. Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und aufmerksam. Ich war da mit meiner kleiner Tochter für ein paar Stunden, da wir aus München weiter nach Santa Fe verreisen müssten. Sehr angenehm. Preis-Leistungsverhältnis stimmt.
Excelente comunicación, con muy buen servicio. Todo muy recomendable y limpio. Muchas gracias.

El departamento es excepcional. La locación para quienes deseen conocer la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, es inmejorable. Todos los transportes públicos, y atracciones principales cerca (teniendo en cuenta lo grande que es la ciudad, claro ésta) . Luciana esta atenta  a que te encuentres cómodo. Tiene el detalle de dejarte unas colaciones, y café sin cargo. Sin duda 100% recomendable

O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos. A Analia é uma anfritiã prática e esta sempre disponível. A localização é o ponto forte do apartamento. Muito perto da Calle Florida e de muitas atrações. Dá para fazer muita coisa andando. Os funcionários so prédio são muito simpáticos. Infelizmente tivemos algunas probleminhas na nossa estadia.
Primeiramente quando chegamos havia pequenas baratas no local. Analia avisou que tinha feito a dedetização porém elas continuavam a aparecer. De qualquer forma ela nos deixou a vontade para cancelar a estadia. 
Segundo, o morador acima do prédio fazia muito barulho das 22:00 até as 5:00 da manhã.  Ou seja, impossível ter uma boa noite de sono. 
Tivemos tambem um pequeno problema com uma infiltração e goteiras na "cozinha" que não nos deixou dormir bem. 
E por fim, eu havia pago uma quantia um pouco maior para fazer um late check out e não pude fazer, ela já havia reservado o apartamento para outras pessoas. Porém, Analia falou que poderia me devolver a quantia e também deixou eu colocar as malas em um quarto no prédio.
Enfim, o apartamento é ok, e se não fosse por esses motivos indizaria com certeza. Porém por conta disso nossa experiencia não foi tão boa.
Excelente localização e o apartamento espetacular

Es un edificio antiguo como muchos de la ciudad, pero él interior del departamento es muy acogedor, y súper tranquilo; pienso que uno como huésped tiene que tomar las medidas necesarias para pasarla bien resolviendo cualquier situación que se presente y no andarse quejando por todo.
Excelente anfitriona, muy amable, puntual, responsable y un apartamente bellisimo
Julian fue muy amable y nos apoyo mucho con el Check in -out, Lugar muy bien ubicado.

Un apartamento con una ubicación estratégica, muy bueno el barrio y con sistemas de transporte cerca para moverte a cualquier sitio de la Ciudad.
Liliana es una persona muy servicial y está pendiente a todo momento de sus huéspedes.
El apartamento tiene un estilo moderno, el aseo es impecable, esta completamente dotado, es estar como en casa, ademas esta lleno de detalles.
Lo recomiendo para estar en la ciudad, pasamos una excelente estancia.

We had a lovely stay at Eugenia and Mariano's place in Recoleta! The apartment is beautiful and looks just like the photos. It had everything we needed with lots of light. The extra bathroom was very convenient to have. The building and apartment felt very secure. The location is extremely convenient for exploring Recoleta and with easy access to many of the main tourist sites. The subte is just down the street and Eugenia very kindly left us a card with some rides already loaded. There are some excellent restaurants and cafes within close walking distance. Eugenia was very friendly and helpful and quick to respond. She tracked our flight so that it wasn't a problem when our check-in was delayed and gave us a good suggestion to change our money. There was even a nice Argentine snack waiting for us when we arrived! I would definitely recommend this apartment. Gracias Eugenia y Mariano !
Excelente ubicacion para disfrutar Buenos Aires, lugar excelente y muy tranquilo.

The apartment is close to shops, public transport and it's walking distance to everything. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. The apartment is small but it matches the price. Tamia made it really easy for me to check-in and out. She was friendly and answered all my questions.
La ubicación es perfecta. Cerca de parques, restaurantes y actividades culturales. Alejandra cuida de cada detalle para que la estadía sea muy agradable. Recomiendo mucho este lugar.

The apartment was quite tastefully decorated and well furnished. It gets lots of light and is in a quiet, pretty, and centrally located neighborhood. Joaquin waited several hours for me to arrive since my flight was late. He provided several complimentary gifts, including a bottle of wine, beer and soft drinks and some crackers and nuts. I had a very nice stay.

Recomendo muito a estadia!
Passamos ótimos momentos em Buenos Aires, com a localidade perto do metrô (andando uns 10 minutos até estação Bulnes) e do shopping Alto Palermo, lojinhas na região, parques, padarias, mercados próximos e Uber sempre à disposição.
Porteiros simpáticos, prédio completo, com piscina e sauna (que não usamos porque estava inverno), academia, vizinhos tranquilos, apartamento lindo, muito confortável, limpo e fácil de limpar (como ficamos 10 dias, varremos alguns dias), wi-fi muito bom e varandinha com vista para a rua.
A região possui vários pontos para visitar por perto como parques, museus que dá para ir a pé e para sair a noite, o bairro é o mais recomendado, tanto para boates (boliches como chamam lá) como para restaurantes e bares, dessa forma não se gasta tanto com Uber.
Já com saudades da rotina de Buenos Aires!

This apartment is ideal for everyone.  Excellent neighborhood, close transportation to everywhere, safe area.
The cleanliness could not be better. The apartment is new; therefore, everything is in perfect conditions. Beautiful view and a lot of sun light.
Javier and his wife are very kind, they make you feel very comfortable. Also, the communication is excellent.
I recommend this apartment, you will spend a pleasure time there.

All in all I am very happy I made my choice to stay in Violeta apartment. 5 weeks. I travelled with two very young children. I did and also learned empirically that i can fully trust Violeta. Violeta was our personal concierge! - booked taxi when needed, took me to a doctor, met us at the airport etc. Brought to us a lovely social network, which we miss a lot now back at home. At Violeta building entrance door is daily fresh fruit and vegetable stand. That was an asset for us. We walked a lot and location was very good. Many thanks, Violeta!!!
Ubicación excelente. Maria Isabel nos ayudó/facilitó con la llegada y salida mucho.

Leila was a great host, very friendly. The room was super clean, comfortable, and spacious with a huge bathroom just for you. All spotless . The house has a great peaceful vibe and the location is perfect. Close to everything you need. I will definitely come back to her house next time.
Amazing apartment and perfect location. As a female traveling alone, I never felt unsafe in the apartment or neighborhood. Juan José is very nice and responsive.

I can’t recommend enough of this place. Communication with the host before and after checkin was smooth. The host was very responsive and accommodating. The apartment itself is an attractive - so beautifully decorated with all amenities you’d need in place. I’m so glad I found this place.
Bien... linda piscina, barrio tranquilo

O apartamento da Marisa, é excelente, tudo bem limpinho,bem organizado, móveis novos, ótima localização perto de mercados, fruteiras, shopping, e muitos passeios da para ir a  Pé. Várias linhas de ônibus que passam em frente

This flat is a fantastic space in a great neighborhood (Palermo) in Buenos Aires. The apartment is clean, quiet and spacious with modern furnishings. Hila & Juan were great hosts, even though they live in Barcelona, and despite the time difference were responsive to our questions about what to do. If my wife and I return to Buenos Aires, we would definitely stay here again!

El monoambiente de Franco está impecable, renovado y muy limpio. Está ubicado a una cuadra de la avenida Corrientes cerca de bares, cines y teatros. Es ideal para escapadas cortas. Fue una buena experiencia!!

I was only able to stay here for 2 nights, but the experience was great! This apartment is in a very secure building that has 24 hour security.  The location was very close to the subway as well as many restaurants and bars.  The host was super helpful in every aspect and we really appreciated his help in arranging our transpiration to and from the airport.  The apartment was cute, clean, and perfect for 2 people.

El alojamiento de Julián y Bárbara es muy cómodo y agradable. Amplio y perfectamente equipado. Julián nos facilitó el ingreso al depto unas horas antes de lo pactado sin ningún inconveniente y con excelente predisposición. Les agradezco y seguramente volveremos a alojarnos.
Cómodo y muy bien ubicado! Muy amable Fernanda y su familia!!! Excelente opción
Este departamento fue muy limpio y perfecto para nosotras. Está ubicado muy central entre Palermo Soho y Palermo Hollywood, perfecto para conocer los dos barrios.
Ótimo apartamento, excelente localização e receptividade do Nacho. Voltando a Buenos Aires certamente me hospedaria novamente no apartamento.
Mabel es una gran anfitriona, el departamento cumple con todo lo prometido.

I felt totally at home from the moment I arrive. The super who greeted me with the keys is adorable, friendly, professional, and super helpful. The apartment is light and airy and a really easy and comfortable place to settle into. The wifi is superfast and it's an ideal place to live and work. 

We had a few days without water or electricity (sometimes happens in the summer in BA nothing to do with this particular building). Gabriel was always available to answer my questions, even if he couldn't make the local authorities turn back on the amenities! The apartment is on 7th floor, something to remember if you're here in the summer and there is a power outage. 

In terms of location, it's 2 blocks from the metro, a block from DNI dance school and there are two other dance schools within a block also, and a block from a massive gym with a pool. There's are some great fruit shops nearby including a hidden organic place 2 blocks away and a supermarket for essentials within 5 mins walk. All you could wish for!

El departamento es muy hermoso, está ubicado en una zona tranquila y de fácil acceso a principales lugares. Tiene detalles que hacen que la estadía sea muy amena, como cosas para desayuno y una limpieza y calidez por parte del anfitrión de para destacar. Sin dudas recomiendo 100 % este alojamiento, ha sido mi mejor estadía en Buenos Aires.
Lindo departamento, cómodo y confortable perfecto para lo que necesitábamos Caro siempre al pendiente muchas gracias ;) altamente recomendable ❤️

If you want to experience the trendy neighborhood of Palermo Hollywood you won't regret staying in this flat. The location is absolute perfect! You have everything you need just right outside your doorstep. The flat is spacious and well equipped with everything you need. We also enjoyed the rooftop very much. From there you can see the beautiful city of Buenos Aires. Florencia is an attentive host and we will definitely come back.

I had a fantastic time in this apartment. The photos are true indicative and i thought it was very stylish. One of the best things about it was the bed.... new and very comfy with soft pillows. The internet connection was the weakest link but in my experience in Bs As the internet service is never really that great... not sure why. Location wise is great and Valeria was very attentive, kind and helpful. i highly recommend it.

Maria was a great host, very communicative and helpful. Ideal location in Palermo, close from metro station, supermarket, with many nice cafés and restaurants. the apartment is nicely organized, with a large terrace on the street. definitely recommend it.
Stylish, clean space in perfect location! Great accommodation and communication with hosts.
Excelente ubicación
Great place to stay, great location, very secure, and close to lots of great restaurants. Apartment was very clean and everything was in great condition. Hosts were very helpful!

Muy cómodo y moderno, en una ubicación inmejorable! Muy recomendado. Solo una de las fotos no coincide con el departamento, el resto es igual. Todo equipado para las necesidades básicas. Muchas gracias por esperarnos y recibirnos!

Eu e minha noiva fomos agora em maio/19 e não temos palavras para agradecer o Damian, que além de ser um anfitrião super simpático se colocou à disposição em todos os aspectos passando informações tanto da acomodação bastante precisas como também dicas do que poderíamos fazer em Buenos Aires ou conhecer ao redor da Recoleta alguns lugares onde normalmente não se encontra fácil pela internet. 

Além disso nos passou o contato no (Hidden by Airbnb) assim que fomos recebidos para que a qualquer tempo pudéssemos ter contato direto com ele. Apartamento super limpo e com ótimas instalações e super bem cuidado.

Por fim, no checkout foi bastante atencioso e ainda conseguimos bater um bom papo e com certeza se algum outro dia eu voltar a Buenos Aires, ele será uma pessoa que irei procurar novamente caso esteja disponível tanto para acomodação ou até mesmo para tomar um bom vinho e uma boa cerveja para bater um papo. 

Obrigado Damian, você foi demais! Super recomendo a todos o espaço do damian para se acomodar e ficar em um apartamento top e próximo a tudo. 

Nota (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) !
Patricia was a perfect host, easy communication, a lot of tips, clean flat, great and safe location. To sum it up: everything was perfect! Thanks!
Increíble ubicación, muy limpio y cómodo!

Excelente ubicación! El departamento moderno,excelente, cómodo y completo. Ari
Muy atento en todo lo que necesite. Lo recomiendo 100%
Excelente atención, siempre dispuestos para ayudar. El departamento 100% recomendado, está impecable y excelente ubicación

We highly recommend this place for your stay in Buenos Aires! Our family found it well located, tidy, comfortable and spacious enough for a two week stay.  You have all you need in walking distance: cafes, restaurants, shops, grocery stores, parks, laundrys, etc. Visiting places farer away in the city is easy by subte or by taxi. The host Susana is very nice and easy to communicate with.

For y Atilio son dos genios! hicieron muy placentera mi estancia en su casa.
La habitación es hermosa, todo esta muy limpio, el barrio tiene muchos bares y restaurantes, hermosos cafes. 
Gracias por los mates, la torta y las charlas, por compartir su casa conmigo :)
Recomiendo este lugar sin dudarlo 


Flor and Atilio are two geniuses! They made my stay at their home very pleasant.
The room is beautiful, everything is very clean, the neighborhood has many bars and restaurants, beautiful cafes. 
Thanks for the mates, the cake and the talks, for sharing your house with me :)

I recommend this place without hesitation.

Ana is a great host. The communication was easy and she was very nice and flexible. The appartment is small but has everything you could need. The decoration is great. The location is nice. I warmly recommand this house and its host. Gracias Ana

Muy lindo lugar. Silencioso y espacioso. 
Tenés la comodidad de tener la llave de la casa y de la habitación. La ubicación tiene muchos lugares de interes cercanos y con gusto 100% porteño. Bares, cervecerias, parrillas, antigüedades. Muy lindo para recorrer.

The place was a clean studio in a nice area, really close to everything. Eduardo accommodated the check-in time when my flight was changed and the doorman was always very helpful. The keys were left for me at the front desk and the apartment had everything you could ask for (kitchen, bed, balcony, bathroom, etc) ...even cleaning service if you needed more towels or sheets!

El departamento es muy luminoso y tiene unos atardeceres preciosos ya que esta en un piso alto, pero el downside de todo esto es la experiencia que uno se lleva al entrar al departamento, siendo que tiene muchísimo olor a cigarrillo el cual esta adherido a todas las telas, almohadas, colchón, etc. Para los no fumadores esto es terrible ya que el olor termina en la ropa, en la piel, etc.. El otro aspecto negativo, que en las fotos del listing no se ve, es que el departamento esta un poco deteriorado. Para ser un edificio de 8 años de antigüedad, este departamento no lo demuestra ya que tiene problemas de humedad en las paredes que dan al exterior. Por ultimo la limpieza, lamentablemente me toco poner el departamento patas para arriba, gastar mucho dinero en productos de limpieza (ya que en el departamento solo había detergente para los platos) y un par de días para dejarlo en condiciones. Lo positivo que tiene el edificio es que tiene laundry con seca ropas,  una mini piscina y una parrilla en a azotea. La zona es un 10, volvería a elegir de nuevo esta zona, pero lamentablemente no en este alojamiento siendo que  mi experiencia no fue positiva.

Cristina's flat is located in the pretty area of Recoleta. It is very easily to reach by subte. From the flat I was also able to walk to many places I wanted to see. I spent a week in her flat while doing a Spanish course in the nearby quarter of Retiro. Very close to the flat there are many shops and restaurants and also the famous cemetary of Recoleta. I felt very good and safe in this neighbourhood. The flat itself is located in a pretty building on a major street, but because it is on the 8th floor, it is also very quiet. The flat is very clean and nicely decorated. The room has a double bed and an ensuite bathroom. Cristina was very accomodating, very easy to contact and  provided me with a subte card, information about Buenos Aires and a map. She doesn't speak any English, but for me that was good as I wanted to improve my Spanish. Overall a very pleasant stay!
O studio de Lidia é excelente e muito charmoso. Fica próximo ao metrô e ao shopping, facilitando muito a estadia. Lidia é muito prestativa e sempre disposta a ajudar.

Great apartment with super comfortable bed and in a nice area of BA! The host was very responsive and even let us store our luggage for a day when we left BA for a day trip and came back. Very helpful.

Excelente ubicación, muy espacioso departamento. Todo es justo como está en la descripción. Adriana es muy atenta, comunicarse con ella fue muy fácil y estuvo ahí muy tarde en la noche para recibirnos y entregarnos las llaves del departamento.

I highly recommend staying with Andrea.  The apartment is located in a nice and safe building at a busy street in a very safe area with excellent transportation connections anywhere.  I walked to most places, but there are buses leaving right in front of the house and the Subte (Buenos Aires subway) is just a short walk.  Even though the house is located at a very busy street, the apartment is very quiet - to the point that I slept with window open a few nights when the temperatures allowed.  The room is spacious, nice and clean.  Additionally, you have your own private bathroom which is very nice and new.  Overall, I found everything to be exactly as described, including a well functioning reliable WiFi connection.  On top of that, Andrea is a great host!  I very much enjoyed my stay.
El depto muy hermoso y la ubicacion genial

We stayed about a week at Claudia's apartment and we couldn't have asked for anything more. House was clean, enough space to relax, watch tv, and cook. It was also right in the middle of everything, at the most an hour or maybe 2 hour walk to see everything in the city. 
Best of all, Claudia was immensely helpful and was able to suggest some very fun things to do based on our time and budget, and also accommodated our late check out time, even calling a cab for us when we realized we were planning on going to the wrong bus terminal and would have missed our bus otherwise. Thanks so much Claudia!

My overall experience was exceptional with Agustin and his family.  Their home is beautiful and centrally located, providing access to notable historic areas, shopping and public transportation.  The rooftop terrace and BBQ were also fantastic.

More than anything, the hospitality and warmth of the family were great.  It was my first time in Buenos Aires and Agustin and Maria were exceptionally helpful to me navigating my way around the City.  They were inclusive and made me feel right at home; which was so important to me.  

I would strongly recommend anyone with a desire of traveling to Buenos Aires to stay with Agustin and his family and when I return I plan to stay with them again.

Most probably one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. Diana was helpful, communicative and extremely friendly since the checking in and made my stay wonderful, never disturbing but always available, easy and quick responding. The apartment is in a brilliant location, walking distance to amazing bars and restaurants as well as transport links and green areas. Apartment is new with a very tasteful decoration and furnitures and the green balcony is pretty cool! The building is actually a dream and very secure. I will stay again and again every time I’m back in Buenos Aires.
Anfitriones geniales! el dpto. impecable! mejor ubicación imposible!
Lo mejor que posee el dto es la ubicacion y los detalle de decoracion.

El apartamento es muy lindo, limpio, ordenado  y ubicado en un entorno muy agradable. "Las Cañitas" es un barrio seguro y con muchos restaurantes y bares que ofrecen un gran movimiento para salir y disfrutar de la noche Porteña.  100% recomendable!

José apt in midst of Hip, trendy, urban & super accessible Palermo (Hollywood section) of Buenos Aires. Location location location 
The flat itself is designer level beautiful and perfectly appointed at every turn. It's exactly as the photos show but better because it's 3 dimensional and human. Building is super secure. Neighbors are quiet and street below is close enough to open windows and feel the energy but apt is 4 stories above and thusly removed....
I walked everywhere for five days: everyone of my meetings and socializing. But is also easily accessible to train and public transit and uber was never more than 4-5 minutes away. Check in was simple and human and José was super responsive to any questions via Airbnb messenger. 

Palermo encompasses big parks, mixed use retail dining and lots of safe big streets to walk or run on. 
Greatest recommendation I can give is that this will be my default home in BA whenever it's available
Good place in the centre of town
Excelente atención de Tito y Karina. Muy limpio y ordenado. Nos sentimos muy cómodos y conformes. Volveremos seguramente!

Apartamento bem localizado, próximo a duas estações de metro (10 minutos a pé), perto de um mercado Carrefour 24 hrs, padaria, cafés, restaurantes  e outros mercadinhos e frutarias mais simples. Bairro seguro e constantemente policiado (vimos várias viaturas da policia passando em diversos horários). 
Aconchegante, simples, decoração agradável, bem iluminado e organizado, porém um pouco desgastado (mas não gerou incomodo).
Flor e Nico foram bem prestativos, com respostas rápidas e sempre dispostos a ajudar. Permitiram fazer o check out no fim da tarde, mais próximo do horário do nosso voo. 
Obrigada pela hospitalidade, nos sentimos em casa!

Totally recommended!!! My first Airbnb and was exactly what I needed. Great accommodation very well located, Marcela is adorable and was very attentive. The room was perfect, cleanliness, nothing complain about, the room is exactly as described. Definitely would stay again! Thank you, Marcela!!!

It is perfectly locate, near subway, near bus station. Very close to turistic places. The department is beautiful, have a lot of light and is really well equipped. It also have lot of market very very close if you love to cook your own food and have the great experience of live like a local. In addition Marcela is a great and very kind host.
Hermoso PH reciclado, una joya del diseño en San Telmo, la ubicación es bacán  y esta cerca de todo y la atencion es excelente lo super recomiendo y espeor volver a hospedarme alli
Very slick and brand new. Perfectly designed and great value for money!
Excelente lugar, cómodo , amplio con todas las comodidades, excelente ubicación,  y el trato del dueño espectacular... recomendado 100%

Luísa, é uma pessoa atenciosa e simpática que nos deu todo apoio com informações e dicas sobre o bairro e a cidade. O apartamento é moderno e limpo, muito confortável. Fica num bairro muito gostoso e tranquilo - Belgrano, com maior parte de sua área residencial, porém com tudo perto, cafés, Padaria, mercados, metrô, bons restaurantes e de fácil acesso a outros lugares da cidade, por metrô ou ônibus.
Bom para dormir e para novos descansos em Buenos Aires!

Gri es una persona muy amable, hospitalaria, pero también reservada. La comunicación funcionó muy bien desde antes mi viaje y durante mi estancia. Ella me ayudó mucho con informaciones útiles y arreglar mi teléfono local. El apartamento es sencillo, limpio y la habitación también. La ubicación es céntrica cerca de todo en el centro,ademas San Telmo tiene un encanto,y el apartamento es silencioso por la noche porque da al patio interior no a la calle. Única cosa para mencionar es la calefacción que sólo hay un aparato para todo el apartamento y la habitación no la tiene propia.

Lo recomiendo 1000%. Muy bien ubicado. Además, Dharma es muy amable, preocupada y atenta. Era la primera vez que compartia el depto. Y estaba un poco complicado por la convivencia... pero nada!, todo resulto perfecto! ... El lugar esta muy cerca de: parques, todo tipo de locales comerciales y de toda la locomoción colectiva (una o dos cuadra). Además me ayudo con mucha información desde antes de llegar hasta cuando me fui. Lejos el mejor lugar en que he estado.

Luis made contact both e-mail and a direct telephone call. He also provided a list  of suggested places to vi. The apartment was as advertised, and the area likewise. We were familiar with the area since we had made several prior vs to Buenos Aires. It is a nice city with very friendly people.

Unser Aufenthalt war super. Daniel und Silvina haben uns mega lieb empfangen und alles gezeigt, sowie sehr viele Tipps gegeben. Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt, um Abends  Viertel etwas trinken oder essen zu gehen. Vor allem für junge Leute super!  Wer selbst kochen möchte, findet im AirBnB auch die passende Ausstattung dazu. 
Außerdem konnten wir Check-in und Check-out flexibel vereinbaren. Wir bedanken uns recht herzlich. Vielleicht sieht man sich ja mal wieder. Von unserer Seite aus sehr gerne !
Lindo lugar bien ubicado un poco ruidoso de noche sobre todo los sábados, por lo demás todo ok!
Muy lindo apartamento, cómodo y accesible. Christian muy atento y servicial, sin duda volveremos.

I stayed in Gwenole’s apartment for 5 weeks and I really enjoyed the stay. The location of apartment is perfect - the neighborhood is among the best in the city, and is quiet enough. The major avenue with bus stops and subway station is 2 blocks away. You can find good restaurants 2-4 blocks away, and in 10 blocks you have Palermo Viejo which is a center of nightlife. Palermo parks are 10-15 minutes away by foot. Aeroparque airport is just 20 minutes away by car. 
The building is very well maintained, and has a swimming pool and a terrace. 
The apartment itself is quiet, spacious enough, and looks exactly as on the photos. 
I would definitely recommend the apartment for a long stay in Buenos Aires. 
Thanks much, Gwenole!
Unsurpassed location, beautiful views and layout, easy checkin. Do not expect details or many equipment.

Dear Mr. Sergio (Website hidden by Airbnb) greatly appreciate your kindness and everything you have done to help my trip more comfortable and more interesting.I really like your apartment that close to restaurant, bakery shop, grocery store,... and the most important thing is the safety. I greatly appreciate the guy who you sent to your apartment to show us how to operate everything in your place. Once again I want to to say thank you very much for your help (Website hidden by Airbnb) Loan Nguyen.

Maria and Mom picked us up from airport and drove us to her apartment. It is exactly same with the description on AirB&B: clean/tide, perfect location. Thanks Maria for the the detailed info you provided, all the quick responses and all the efforts you made to make our short stay a wonderful one!

Unbeatable apartment, unbeatable location, unbeatable hosts!!

The apartment was just as it looks in the photos - cute, cosy, homely, and has everything you need for a short or long stay in BsA. The wifi was great, bed comfy, shower excellent, cable TV (not that you'll have much time to watch it with so much going on in the city), a/c, and kitchen with everything you'll need. Secure building and best of all was the balcony where you can enjoy the sun setting through the trees in the evening with a glass or four of local malbec. What I found most useful was the file packed full of restaurant recommendations, city information and general BsA tourist information (including a Lonely Planet guide) which made planning my days so easy. The hosts also provide a Subte (subway) card to make bus and subway travel a breeze.

The location in Palermo Hollywood was fantastic too. A very trendy and lively part of BsA packed with great restaurants and bars, but not so lively as to keep you awake at night. I always felt safe and loved living in a local area as locals live rather than in a hotel full of tourists in a tourist area. 

What really sets this apartment apart from the others, and the reason why I chose it, was the hosts. Before I arrived Claudia (helped by Roxana and Sandra) provided me with heaps of useful arrival information. Despite arriving late on a Saturday night after a 2 hour flight delay, Roxana met me at the door with a smile and again was so helpful settling me in and giving me tips on restaurants and things to do. During my stay the hosts dropped me regular messages to make sure everything was OK, and on checkout Sandra was even kind enough to book my airport taxi and give me a late checkout to match my late flight. Better than any hotel concierge!! Claudia, Roxana, Sandra - thanks for making my trip so easy and so memorable. I will be back!!
muy buen alojamiento.destaco la limpieza y la calidez del departamento de ani.muy buena atencion
Excelente todo un apartamento divino con gran estilo en pleno San Telmo  Andrea  fenomenal anfitriona

Claudia was a wonderful host, so quick to respond and helpful. She made sure that a cab was arranged for us to and from the apartment and recommended us some great spots to try. The apartment is is a cool area and super close to restaurants and bars. Would recommend.

We had a perfect stay at Pame & Nico's apartment.  It is very comfortable, nicely decorated, and located in a newer building in a pleasant residential neighborhood.  Two short blocks to the A subway line which takes you right into downtown (or shopping in Caballito in the opposite direction).  Nico met us upon arrival and was very responsive to communication.  A+++++

Great place at a good spot! We stayed for four nights, used the subway a lot but also walked around everywhere as it is something we love doing. Very thoughtful of them to leave a subway card so we could start using it right away. We arrived at an unnapropriate time at check-in (3am) and they were very kind about it.
We are sure to recommend it and stay there again.

Rosario went above and beyond in making me feel comfortable. We discussed the history of Argentina, she was proactive in setting up communication with me, gave me tips for local necessities, etc. Really amazing!!

My husband, baby and I stay at Francesca's place during a month in December. The place is extremely well located in a beautiful area of the city. It also has the advantage of featuring a big supermarket within 100 mts of distance. Francesca was a great host, very responsive and it accommodate it our check-in time as much as possible. The flat is well equipped and spacious. It has air-conditioner in the living room area, which is extremely useful in the hot summer days in Buenos Aires. Unfortunately, it does not have any fan or air-con in neither of the two bedrooms.
Miguel fue super amable. Le hice la reserva a mi madre y tía, volvieron encantadas con la amabilidad y respuestas rápidas. Muy recomendable.

Es war phantastisch! Wegen eines Streiks kamen wir 4/5 Stunden später als verabredet (mitten in der Nacht) an und Fernando hat die ganze Zeit auf uns gewartet, um uns in die Wohnung zu lassen!!!

Tausend Dank, Fernando, wir wären auch in ein Hotel gegangen. Tausend Dank.

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön und total gut gelegen. Es gibt nette Lädchen, man kommt zu Fuß zum Spielplatz im Parque Lamaze, man kann beim Desnivel spitzenmäßiges Fleisch essen und niemand ärgert sich über Kinder.
Claudia’s apartment is excellent, great setup, very clean, everything we needed, kitchen well equipped, great location, great communication between Claudia and us. Highly recommended.
excelentes anfitriones, ya repeti por tercera vez y seran mas
Departamento moderno, con vista espectacular, tranquilo y bien equipado. Atención rápida, amable y precisa. Altamente recomendable !
The host canceled this reservation the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Lorena fue muy tarde. Nos encontramos a las 19 y cuarto y esperamos 1 hora sobre la lluvia sin comunicar. No disculpo y nada. El departamento es bastante bien y la ubicacion es genial

Diego's flat is amazing ; ideally located in the city centre, comfortable, functional and with everything you need. The flat has air con, a very comfy bed with a very cool relaxing light, and lots of channels on the TV if you're tired after a long day walking/visiting. 
The flat is 10 mins walk from Plaza de Mayo (which is the main square), the area feels very safe, and there are lots of bars & restaurants nearby. We also did a walking tour which leaves right below the flat !
Diego is a very nice guy, he waited for us when we arrived and came back before we left to say goodbye and to check if everything went well. I would really recommend this flat without any hesitation ! have fun in Buenos Aires :)

A great spot in the heart of San Telmo.
Comfy bed, clean, spacious. Also Nora speaks clearly and slowly (for an Argentine).
I'd stay again and I recommend it.

We had an enjoyable time in your apartment. It was clean and well appointed. We found it comfortable, bright, light and airy. Lots of room to spread out and the balcony was an added bonus, to have an outside space without having to go outside. Great to have lots of seating and a good-sized dining table. 

The bedroom was comfortable and the dressing room great, too; good use of space. Lots of storage. The bathroom was lovely, but we did have an issue with the water not flowing in all 3 areas at, sink, bidet and shower.

The kitchen was clean and had everything we needed, but unfortunately couldn't keep the oven lit. We liked that there was washing up liquid and cloths, but it would have been nice to have a 'welcome pack' of water, bread, butter, juice --  just to get started.

We were glad of WiFi, which came with perfect instructions in case it went down.

We would have preferred the TV downstairs; in any case we were unable to get the remote control to work properly.

It might have been good to have a book detailing where the local bakery, greengrocer, bank and supermarkets were, as well as local restaurants walking distance or further away. 

We loved the fact that the apartment was essentially a complex with great amenities and a beautiful pool, gardens, coffee shop. And it felt safe as the back and front entrances were gated and controlled by staff all day. We found that there was a gym area and sauna, too.

We have family in Buenos Aires and it was a perfect location; we would return to the apartment again on our next visit.
Todo se dió de acuerdo a lo pactado. Muy buena ubicación y el departamento está de acuerdo a lo que se ve publicado en las fotos.
Angie es una excelente anfitriona

The location is perfect!  My friend and I booked 'The Argentine Experience' for dinner at the last minute, and it just so happened to be a 15 minute walk from here.   So many choices for wining and dining in this neighbourhood.   The apartment has everything you need and a very comfortable bed!  
I would definitely stay here again.  
Thank you!

Studio muy bien ubicado en el límite entre Recoleta y Palermo, zona tranquila y cerca de todo (shopping, cafés, bares, supermercados) y comunicado con el resto de la ciudad. Lindo balcón a la calle. Silvia es muy atenta y Eugenio también. Hacen muy fácil el ingreso y salida y siempre están disponibles para atender cualquier necesidad o consulta. Recomendable!

A gem in Recoleta perfectly located for moving around the city, or using the gym, pool, sauna for downtime.  Friendly hosts and the building staff is polite and service oriented. Glad I stayed and I will return again if the apartment is available!

Não conheci o Fernando pessoalmente, mas ele estava disponível e respondia às mensagens prontamente. Foi muito solicito e amável se colocando à disposição todo o tempo de nossa estadia.
A localização é excelente. Bairro delicioso com vários restaurantes ótimos perto, e tudo o mais, como farmácia e supermercado.
Só uma observação: o  sofá cama é de solteiro, rsrs... acomoda bem uma criança ou um adulto de estatura média para baixa. Ah... e a rua é bem barulhenta. Se você necessita silêncio total à noite, é complicado. Como isso não me incomoda, me hospedaria novamente!

Muy buena ubicacion del departamento. Excelente el trato de Maria Pia, tanto antes de entrar al departamento como en la estadia y muy cordial y expeditiva en las soluciones que tuvo que tomar. El departamento no solo que es igual a las fotos, sino mejor !!! Muy bien cuidado y acondicionado, y de excelente limpieza cuando llegamos. Muy completo en utensillos de cocina. Sabanas, frazadas y cubrecamas impecables ! Nos hemos sentido muy bien en nuestra estadia en el departamento. Muchas Gracias Maria Pia !!!

The apartment was wonderful. It couldn't have been in a better location. It's in a great neighborhood surrounded by great shops and restaurants a few blocks away. Public transit was very close as well. The check in and check out process was very easy and flexible. I highly recommend this apartment. 

We had originally planned on booking some beds in a hostel but this ended up being almost the same cost but with so much more value. Staying in an apartment in such a great neighborhood added so much to the experience. I said it before but i'll say it again I highly recommend this apartment.
La verdad todo genial!! Maria y Bernardo super amables! Volveremos!
El lugar es cómodo y agradable, buena la ubicación
Lucas un excelente anfitrion con mucha disponibilidad y amabilidad.
Great place to stay. I recommend. The street en the front is a little bit noisy but it’s good location.

I stayed at this place for a month and loved everything about it. The place is as described: large and comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped, the bathroom had great water pressure, the WiFi worked like a charm, there’s lots of natural light. The location is great too. As other reviews have noted, the elevator makes a loud noise, but you’re never going to find a place in Buenos Aires that is 100% quiet.

Muy agradable la estancia donde Juan y su madre, la habitación es tal como lo menciona el anuncio, muy independiente de la casa. Todo muy limpio y en un barrio perfecto para tomarse alg. Definitivamente recomiendo su lugar

A Laura foi uma excelente anfitriã! Rápida nas respostas e muito prestativa. O apartamento superou nossas expectativas! Limpeza bem feita, cama confortável, roupas de cama e banho muito cheirosas, Wi-Fi de qualidade, os utensílios da cozinha nos serviu muito bem, boa localização, e além de tudo, ela teve o cuidado de nos disponibilizar sachês de chá, bolinhos, frutas e kit de amenidades (shampoo, condicionador, sabonete, algodão). Achamos maravilhoso todo esse cuidado da Laura com seus hospedes!

Fantastic apartment in a superb area with a great view. Claudia was extremely helpful in getting me set up in the apartment and also letting me know about things to do and places to eat in the local area.
