El lugar estaba limpio y con todo lo necesario para estar cómodas, exactamente como se ve en las fotos! Súper bien ubicado, con metro y cafés a la vuelta de la esquina. Sin duda volveríamos! Además cuando nos fuimos dejamos un artículo de valor e inmediatamente nos contactaron para pasar a buscarlo, mega recomendado.
Carolina es super hospitalaria. La habitacion muy confortable. Y la ubicación inmejorable

Fabian was so fantastic in accommodating our early check-in time after a long journey from the US, which was hugely appreciated. He also let us store our luggage at his apartment for a few hours on checkout day, another huge help!  Very easy to communicate with Fabian via the Airbnb messenger (quick responses). Five stars!

We LOVED Palermo Soho -- this was by far the best location for foodies and hipsters like us to be based during our stay :). Be sure to check out Don Julio's for lunch or dinner (make a reservation), take a yoga class at Valletierra, and just walk around and explore the area on foot at your leisure.  The apartment was as pictured and described. Beautiful loft! However be advised the stairs both to get to the apartment (2 flights) and also the 1 flight of stairs inside the loft are not well-suited for elderly guests or child guests.

C'est un super Airbnb que nous recommandons sans aucune hésitation.
5 étoiles partout, accueil, propreté, localisation, etc.

Amalia's place was just as we expected and just as advertised. Great area, perfect for what we were looking for. It was our first time in Buenos Aires and we couldn't have asked for better communication and hospitality from Amalia. We would stay here again!
Un apartamento espacioso, útil y bien comunicado con el servicio de transporte público. Cerca hay restaurantes, mercados, tiendas. El anfitrión Mario,  siempre está pendiente de lo que necesites
si buscan tranquilidad y silencio,no será adecuado para uds

This was the first time me and my wife had done a private air bnb room and we loved it, it was hands down one of the best place we have stayed in. Flor was especially helpful with suggestions and both her and max made us feel at home in Palermo. Would love to stay there again in the future.

Este departamento nos ha dado una panorámica de BA diferente. Buenos Aires también se vive en las alturas y es el lugar perfecto para ello. Muy cómodo y tranquilo, con lo necesario (y de sobra) para pasar una estancia en la ciudad. Gastón muy amable, respetuoso y con buenas conversaciones, repetiriamos!!!!!

Lovely clean bright apartment with  cute balcony. We stayed couple of days when we were in Buenos Aires and enjoyed our stay very much. Good location also very close to restaurant shopping mall and shops. 
Do not look further and just book here !

Me pareció un excelente departamento. Ubicado en una Av. muy importante de la ciudad. Súper luminoso, limpio y seguro. Es mucho mas lindo que por foto! Tiene una vista increíble! Ernesto y su hija fueron buenísimos en cuanto a la comunicación como a la buena onda! Altamente recomendable

This studio apartment cannot be beat..!!  As a single-traveler, the décor, location, and prompt attention by management made my time extra special.    Having lived in many apts in Palermo, I can vouch for the quiet ambience (which is unheard of in this part of The City) and the responsible owner.   The apartment is awesome for one person.   And would be great for two..  Highly recommended...

The apartment is located perfectly within the Palermo neighborhood - it just takes you a few steps and you have plenty of nice shops, bars and restaurants. Don’t miss to enjoy a morning coffee or evening beer on the apartments rooftop - it’s a dream! Thanks to Raul and Francesco, communication was brilliant and the place is beautiful.
Impecable lugar, excelente ubicación trato increíble, comunicación inmejorable, si tuvieran 10 estrellas sin duda se las ganan. Yo sin pensarlo regresaría a su estudio.

The apartment is great and well-maintained, in a fantastic neighbourhood, walking distance from the Palermo parks, stores and night-life. Ezequiel was a perfect host, punctual, flexible and very helpful. One minor issue is that, because it is in the first floor, the apt can be a bit noisy; nothing that ear plugs won't solve. I will certainly return and highly recommend.
Muy buena la ubicación del Depto!! Muy atento y amable el anfitrión. Hermosa vista! Súper recomendable

El departamento está muy buen ubicado, a unos metros de la Av. Santa Fé y a menos de una cuadra a la estación de subte (o metro) y con muchísimos paraderos de bus a 2 cuadras a la redonda. A menos de una cuadra hay muchas bodegas y a 4 cuadras hay 2 supermercados. A 1 cuadra y media hay una casa de cambio, un locutorio y montones de negocios más.
El departamento tiene una distribución muy cómoda, buena presión de agua, la cocina miy bien equipada.
Excelente ubicación. Lindo depto. Luminoso. Muy recomendable. Ariel muy atento.

Viajé con mi madre de 62 años y solo puedo deci (Website hidden by Airbnb) L. La casa es hermosa, la ubicación perfecta para gente que quiere patear la ciudad y después relajarse, los anfitriones simpatiquísimos... Si vuelvo a Buenos Aires repetiría sin duda!!!

My best Airbnb experience ever! Abrazos grandes on check-in, tons of useful tip and reccomendation, excellent communication, stylish, clean & cozy appartment. If I would build my home, I would do it in the same way as this amazing appartment is organized. Stayed for 25 nights and it flew like one. I felt absolutely at home there.
*P.S. balcony view makes morning coffee a kind of a breathtaking routine.

This is the second time I have stayed in an apartment in Buenos Aires that Marcos has offered. 

From checkin, to check out, everything was smooth and wonderful.  The apartment is clean, comfortable, and like home.

I'll be staying with Marcos in the future if I can, without a doubt.

La estadía en el monoambiente fue muy buena para nosotros. El espacio es bien funcional, cómodo y acogedor. Hermosa biblioteca para bucear. A media cuadra de Corrientes y cerca de todo, buses, Metro B y locales.
Todo espectacular volvería
Maravillosa experiencia, recomiendo este listing a toda la comunidad Airbnb. El departamento es una joya y el servicio de Facundo y Federico impecable

Tranquilidad, el barrio es silencioso. Bien ubicado, tiene al alcance varios supermercados.
El garage es un plus excelente.
Excellent , the place was as described. Everything great.
Great place to stay, good value, great location

Eduardo’s place is a fantastic space. Super clean, quiet, and a great location. Eduardo was easy to communicate with and very responsive to any questions/concerns I had. The outdoor garden space was perfect! I spent a lot of time in the hammock reading and relaxing. This was by far one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed at! It is in a very cool historic building and the apartment had everything needed to make yourself at “home”, cook meals, relax, and sleep silently! I highly recommend staying at Eduardo’s on your trip to BA and if I return I hope to do so!!
Great stay at Luciano's place. The location is excellent and he is so responsive!

Federico's place was great! We were welcomed by a friend who explained to us the space in person and waited for our late check-in. The place was exactly how we had imagined it would be, in the center of San Telmo, ideal walking distance from the market and from amazing life next to plaza Dorrego! Very nice bathroom and shower, different types sleeping spaces perfect for couples or even friends,  and good wifi access!  Would recommend this place if you are traveling with a group of friends!
Lugar muy limpio y cómodo. Muy minimalista, perfecto para quedarse con un bebé.
Excelente ubicación y Excelente host. Hiper recomendado

Apartamento de Mauricio muy agradable y super limpio. se encuentra entre Palermo y Recoleta. La hospitalidad de Mauricio hace que la estancia sea muy agradable. la cama cómoda y la internet rápida. ¡Muchas gracias Mauricio por la gran estancia!

Pros: Very nice apartment in San Telmo. Loved the decoration and how spacious it was. Lots of restaurants and attractions nearby. The subway is just a couple of blocks away. Naomi was very helpful and and took good care of us.

Cons: The only con is that one of the sofas smelled like dog pee. We were trying to watch some TV after a long day and this awful smell just kept coming up. It was better once we moved to the small sofa but still kinda annoying :/

I spent a really nice week in Rodrigo's airbnb, the apartment is really functional and was clean ! There is everything you need (in particular in the kitchen). Good location in Recoleta, next to the subway and supermarkets. Rodrigo was also very receptive and answering quickly on the platform which was helpful as my phone wasn't working. Thanks again !

The apartment was clean, the owner took the time to explain us everything, it was a very good experience! 
Don't hesitate !
Lovely stay. Gabriela's place has it all. Plus she and her mother made my check in and out super convenient. I hope to stay again!

El apartamento de Fernando está genial!La habitación es amplia  acogedora, la cama es muy cómoda, y ademas tiene un salón y cocina que vienen muy bien!
La situación estupenda, en el barrio de San Telmo en una zona segura para caminar también de noche y con muchas opciones gastronómicas alrededor. 
Fernando nos trató genial, nos aconsejo con las dudas que teníamos, siempre estaba disponible por teléfono si lo necesitábamos  y hasta nos llamo un taxi que necesitamos para ir a la terminal del bus para desplazarnos al aeropuerto!
100% recomendable!
Es un lugar que se encuentra muy bien ubicado, con las facilidades del caso.
The house is fascinating in a very interesting neighborhood, and the owner and staff were considerate and friendly. We enjoyed Buenos Aires.

Muy amable, nos ofreció todo lo prometido, nos recibió a la hora acordada y nos ayudó en el transporte al aeropuerto. La zona muy céntrica, cerca de los principales atractivos turísticos de la ciudad. Recomendable.
Todo excelente. Departamento muy bien ubicado, bien equipado, y limpio! Ideal para una familia. Gracias por todo!
Nice room with a great view. Catalina was an excellent host, very friendly and helpful. highly recommended.

Everything went smoothly and perfect, Maria answered me very quickly and since I don't speak Spanish we were able to discuss everything in English.

For an additional charge we were allowed to move into the apartment much earlier than stated, Maria is very accommodating, she reacts very quickly and tries to make everything possible for her guests.

I highly recommend this apartment, it is located in the best district of the city - bars, restaurants and supermarkets are on the same street, the subway is only a few blocks away ( Maria has even a SUBE card for her guest, which you need for the subway) as well as a huge shopping street is very close. 

Everything you need and like you can find In and around this apartment, it is fully equipped, from the kitchen to the bathroom- it leaves nothing to be desired, also good for a longer stay.

Thank you Maria for your hospitality and who knows, maybe come to buenos aires again :)

Pablo es una persona muy agradable. El departamento está muy bien ubicado, me gustó El Barrio. A dos cuadras del subte y a pocas cuadras de estación de tren. Es una buena zona. 
Departamento luminoso y cómodo

Tuvimos una excelente comunicación con Adrian, quien nos recibió personalmente en el departamento a la hora acordada para nuestra llegada. Fue muy atento y amable.
El departamento es funcional, con el equipamiento para pasar una estadía agradable. Todo estaba limpio y nos resultó cómodo.
El edificio está a pasos de paradas de colectivos, a pocas cuadras de 2 líneas de subte (A y B) y se llega al centro de la ciudad rápidamente.
Lo recomendaría y volvería a quedarme allí.
Muchas gracias Adrian!

We stayed two nights at Flors beautiful apto. The place is very nice, clean an quiet. Flor helped with all questions we had and stayed in contact the whole time. The neighborhood is very nice with a lot of restaurants and a nice flee market.
Sin duda, mi mejor experiencia a través de Airbnb. Es por ello que regreso a este departamento siempre que puedo. Muy acogedor y cómodo. Me siento como en casa.

We loved to stay at Maria Lucrecia's House.
She was so quick to answer to our request, just a few hours before we arrived in Buenos Aires.

The house is like in the pictures and very well located in the heart of San Telmo.

We really felt like at home, she was very kind and helpful during our stay.

I definitely recommend her house.

El departamento de Manuela es muy cómodo. Tiene wi-fi y esta cerca de muchos medios de transporte, a poco tiempo del centro y de las afueras de la ciudad. Su hospitalidad es excelente, y la habitación muy cómoda.
Nice place in new building, market downstairs, perfect if you want to hang out in La Boca
El apartamento es muy acogedor y goza de una excelente vista desde el cielo de la ciudad

Bem localizado, funcional e boa relação custo benefício. Hospedar-se em Palermo é uma maravilha. O apartamento é bem montado, o prédio é seguro (portaria 24h) e fica próximo de lojas, mercadinhos, ótimos restaurantes (como o L’Adesso e Cabrera), e cafés (Pani, um local lindamente decorado e ótimo para um café da manhã). Fora alguns problemas relacionados à comunicação (mensagens respondidas com atraso por Juan, neto de Berta) , quantidade de toalhas de banho (apenas duas, reclamei mas o problema não foi resolvido) e a um barulho nas persianas, que estavam soltas, gostamos de ficar no local, que tem uma boa relação custo-benefício. Agradecemos a estadia.
Todo excelente! Muchas pero muchas gracias
Agradable departamento...todo renovado y muy agradable...Lola muy buena anfitriona...muy amable!!!...tuvimos agradable estadia

Ari es un excelente host, así como también su padre y Emi. Realmente me sentí super a gusto.  Ari cuidó de todos los detalles y no olvidó de nada. Su departamento es super funcional :) y cerca de todo ;)

Nous n avons jamais vu notre hôte ( clés récupèrees dans une consigne ) .Cependant nous avons toujours eu des réponses rapides à nos questions .Bon emplacement avec des commerces . Appartement très propre
Recomendable, excelente departamento, muy buena ubicación, la seguridad impecable, muy buena anfitriona Carolina.
The host canceled this reservation 27 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

L’appartement de Sofia a parfaitement correspondu à nos attentes. Pour un couple restant trois jours à Buenos Aires, c’était parfait. L’aménagement atypique de l’appartement (chambre accessible par la terrasse) a rajouté un certain charme à notre séjour. Nous nous sommes globalement sentis en sécurité dans le quartier. Plaza de Mayo facilement accessible en 15 minutes de marche.
Communication was fast and easy. The accomodation is great value. Really nice room and well located. Would stay there again.

Marcos was a faultless host. Always friendly and kind and thought of everything and anything to make my stay as comfortable as possible. 
His home is beautifully decorated and open air and is in a nice neighbourhood close to the subte if you want to travel further but definitely walking distance from good restaurants and bars.
Would definitely recommend and would stay again!
Emma was very responsive and thoughtful about how she received us at check-in.  The apartment was exactly like in the pictures, and we greatly enjoyed the terrace during the evening.
Muy buen lugar. Nos sentimos acogidos de principio a fin. Flor, muy preocupada de sus huéspedes y además, muy barato. Recomendado.
great flat great host nice área of the city lot,s of shops around the flat but fare from the tourist area
Muy buena atención,  el dpto se encuentra en buena localización,  los porteros son muy amables .gracias por todo..
Vero muy amable! excelente anfitriona, muy cuidadosa, atenta a los mensajes, el depto es bello, muy bien ubicado, cómo para andar y seguro para salir a caminar de noche. Altamente recomendable! :D

Great stay at Marcela's place. Very good location (15-30 min walk to most places you wanna see). Marcela is very nice and helpfull. She even helped me to book opera tickets. Thanks a lot for everything Marcela.
We had a great time staying here. Very comfortable place in a great location. Francisco made the e iré stay very pleasant.
Todo estaba tal cual el anuncio , muy buena ubicación

We had a great time in Santiago's apartment. It was very clean, the location was good (very close to Palermo where it all happens) and Santiago was a very friendly host. Our flight was delayed, so we were later as expected at the apartment and that was not a problem at all. We would definitely recommend it.

A beautiful apartment in a great location. There are excellent restaurants right across the street and it's in walking distance to Plaza Dorrego and the wonderful shops in Defensa Street. It's a great base to explore Buenos Aires. Walter responded to our initial request very quickly. Maria greeted us at check-in, she is lovely and gave us some great tips for our stay in Buenos Aires. The apartment is very spacious with three bedrooms and two bathrooms. I loved the original antique tiles in the foyer and hallway.
Departamento cómodo, equipado con lo necesario para la estadía. Muy buena ubicación.
The appartment and neigbourhood are amazing. James is a great host, any question we had was immediaty taken care of. If I go back to BA, I'll contact him for sure!

Karina é muito simpática e uma boa anfitriã, seu apartamento é muito confortável e localização excelente, porém tivemos um problema de black-out entre os dias 16 e 17 de junho na Argentina. Ficamos dois dias sem energia e não fomos acolhidos por ela porque era um domingo e segunda era feriado, ficamos dois dias sem energia. Ela prometeu reembolso de 1 estadia. Como isso foi um caso a parte acho que foi mais uma infelicidade mesmo.

It was quite impossible to take a shower, because the bathtub was clogged up! The hot water lasted like 3-5 minutes and then you have to wait to have it again. Outside the building that was super safe, I would say to pay extra attention to the neighborood! Other than this, the 27th floor was amazing and the bed very cosy!
Nice clean and stylish apartment in a great area of BA. Excellent communication from Julien made everything very easy.

Positives: location is perfect, and Pablo was super responsive. The apartment is big - looks just like the pictures.

Negatives: these are all out of the owner's control, but we thought fellow travelers should know:
1) the building has terrible soundproofing. You can hear every roll of the neighbor's dog's ball on the floor, and we were woken up every morning of our stay when they opened their very squeaky door (hopefully this will get fixed).
2) the apartment is on the 2nd floor of a 10-story building, and its only window opens into an air shaft. We had six weeks in BA, so maybe in a normal length of stay this wouldn't have bothered us, but the absence of natural light started to get to us.

Pablo was great, though, and did everything in his power to make our stay wonderful. The neighborhood is full of amazing bars and a dazzling array of restaurants, especially if you like burgers (normally I barely eat red meat, but we had burgers once a week in this crazy town!) Be sure to explore the local roof decks, and catch a polo game if you can!

Great food, amazing company, and a beautiful atmosphere all in one place. What else could be asked for? 

Unlike any other time, it was just me and Paulo throughout the whole experience. He was the perfect gentleman, very considerate and insightful about the places we visited and the culture behind bars in all of its extent, not just in Brazil.

Had an amazing time and will definitely be doing it once again on my travels there...

Thanks for everything Paulo.

Cheers !
IMPECABLE ,UBICACION IDEAL Y PERSONAL MUY AMABLE.

Un lugar muy lindo en un barrio maravilloso, los anfitriones nos facilitaron las cosas para ingresar y salir en los horarios de nuestros vuelos.
Lo único que puede resultar incómodo, es llegar con mucho equipaje ya que el estilo del departamento incluye pasillos angostos y escaleras bastante incómodas.

We stayed at the apartment for almost 6 weeks, extending our stay twice. The place appears just as seen in the images and is in a fantastic location, around the corner from the metro station and many shops, restaurants and cafes. Eleanora was out of town but always very quick to respond to emails and Milagros who looks after the apartment was a very friendly lady always able to offer help or answer questions. Overall we had a great stay and recommend this place. Good for a couple and great value.
Great place, great location, very clean. Right across from a good bar, and near San Telmo Market

Si optas por este lugar deberas saber que tu elección es muy acertada. Es un departamento bellísimo, luminoso, con detalles simples y muy buen gusto en la decoración, muy cómodo en sus tres plantas; y silencioso, se encuentr (Website hidden by Airbnb) cuadras de avenidas concurridas, cerca de transporte publico y  accesible a bares y restaurantes de la zona. Podes recorrer el barrio a pie, es seguro y tranquilo. 
La persona que te recibe es muy buena onda, y siempre esta pendiente de la necesidad del huésped. Nuestra estadía fue muy agradable, aunque no fuimos por ocio o turismo, lo disfrutamos como nuestra casa. 
No dudaría en hospedarme nuevamente aquí en nuestro próximo viaje.

This place was located in the heart of great transportation, restaurants, things to do, etc.  The apartment was very roomy and comfortable. It more than met our expectations! Would definitely stay there again! Was so nice having Greg next door...what a charming and interesting person!

This lovely  appartment is in a  beautiful building in Recoleta. It has everything you need for a few days in the city.   It is well located, within easy walking distance of Recoleta Cemetery and quite a few other historical locations. There is a small supermarket across the road and a number of great eating places close by. Not to mention it being right in the middle of a great shopping area. We travel alot but this was our first airbnb,  we were a bit unsure if what to expect in way of support from our hosts. Once again we couldn't be happier, Gabriel and Sebastian were wonderful hosts.  They arranged an airport transfer for our arrival. A few days in to our stay, we contacted them and asked if they could arrange one for our departure which they gladly assisted us with. We would recommend  the appartment,  the hosts and the location, to anyway looking for a great place to stay in Buenos Aires.

Mila is a great host. She contacted us to see how everything was going through out our stay. The apartment pics don't make it justice, it's more beautiful than it seems. Everything was super clean, we had all the amenities we needed (and more), heated, cozy, comfortable beds, pillows and blankets, and awesome location. The train station is right there. It's an incredible apartment. Don't think it too much, you are gonna get your money's worth and more. Book it.
Departamento con ubicación excelente

This is a great place. Perfect location next to park in Palermo Soho surrounded by cafes and restaurants. The feeling is old world charm with high tech amenities. Beautiful wood floor in the living room and a sleek modern design in the kitchen. The TV, internet and air conditioners all work great. The extra bathroom is very convenient too. We spent Christmas eve and day here and liked it so much we came back for another stay. Highly recommend you check it out.

La casa de Danny es un encantó! Es muy cómoda y bien situada, no le falta nada y la decoración es bien argentina! Se duerme perfecto ya que el dormitorio da sobre un patio interior. El barrio es muy agradable, con restaurantes simpáticos y originales. Hay comercios y vida, todo lo que uno busca.
Volveremos en una próxima estadía en buenos aires!
Buena ubicación, linda pileta y buena disposición para necesidades, gracias!

Barbara and Gascon were outstanding.   I made an early reservation and I had many questions for months.   They were very prompt and explicit about their recommendations.  The place was great for us, a family of 4. We had all we needed near by.   The neighborhood is diverse and very convenient.  We enjoyed BA and Barbara and Gaston were critical for our experience.  They made themselves available during our stay as well.

I highly reccomend  this place! It's a tastefully furnished apartment in a nice neighbourhood (close to plaza de mayo). The entrance is very chique, almost as if you're entering an art gallery. The doormen are helpful and friendly. Melisa and her brother are also very helpful and respond immediately to e-mails.  Thanks for having us. We ❤ Buenos Aires!

Cristina y Carlos son muy amables y te hacen sentir como en casa, el departamento es muy acogedor y confortable, la ubicación es muy buena y bastante segura. No dudaría en volver a hospedarme allí, es muy agradable compartir y charlar con ellos.
Lugar como, limpio y con una excelente ubicación.
El apartamento es tal cual las fotos. Esta en una ubicación inmejorable, con todas las comodidades y María Lía fue realmente muy agradable y cuido los detalles. Apartamento super recomendable!

Arturo e sua esposa nos receberam muito bem!! O apartamento é exatamente o que está nas fotos, tudo funcionando perfeitamente. Além disso, a localização não poderia ser melhor, muito fácil acesso.  Altamente recomendado!!
Dpto cómodo, lugar tranquilo y ubicación céntrica.
El lugar es perfecto, muy cerca de muchos lugares turísticos, Alberto me indicó muy bien para empezar a conocer la ciudad, es una persona muy amable. 100% recomendable.
Un lugar muy acogedor y Marta es una excelente host, nos atendió genial y muy atenta

El departamento es muy bonito, bien equipado, acogedor, se disfruta mucho de la terraza y esta en una buena ubicación. Osar fue un excelente anfitrión, preocupado, amable y con muy buena disposición. 
Recomiendo 100% el lugar y volveríamos a ir.
A great find, if you are looking for a small space that has all the pure essentials. Centrally located, so you're walking distance to many attractions. Many interesting items on the main street.
Muy buen sitio, cerca a varios lugares muy lindos de Buenos Aires.

Los anfitriones estuvieron siempre muy atentos a nuestras necesidades. El apartamento es muy lindo, cómodo y limpio. Buena ubicación. 
Gracias

Georgina is a great host. Even a few weeks before our arrival, she called us several times asking us if there was anything else we may needed.
During our stay, she was constantly offering herself to help us in any way.
But as a matter of fact, the place was perfect; exactly the same as it was described in the listing, or perhaps even better.
The location is in my opinion, the best in Buenos Aires.
Fede cumple con todo lo ofrecido y más, es muy atento y siempre está si lo necesitás. Muuuuy aconsejable, el dpto maravilloso!!!!!

Amazing stay in this Airbnb! Hosts were very friendly and had excellent communication. They were also flexible and helpful in giving us  a few recommendations. We were greeted with a variety of snacks and refreshments, which was nice after a long flight. Place was in a great location and it felt safe to walk outside at anytime of the day or night. We would definitely come back here!

Great apartment, looks exactly as on pictures. I have spent 2 weeks there and have no complaints except, maybe the construction work noise outside, but it is definitely not the fault of the host. 
The apartment is cozy and very nice, the location is perfect, I would love to stay there for longer. Thank you very much for the wonderful experience!

Depto. de excelente e inmejorable ubicación, realmente uno baja y todo queda a pasos, para disfrutar relajado.  Es cómodo y en un edificio tranquilo. Yllen  siempre esta atenta a cualquier requerimiento de manera rápida y cordial. Estuvo dispuesta y considerada a dejar nuestro equipaje antes y después de los checks, detalle que le agradecemos mucho.
Altamente recomendable

La casa es hermosa, luminosa y espaciosa. Ambientes amplios vista abierta. Siempre todo impecable.  La arquitectura moderna y con estilo. Las personas de la casa fueron muy amables y respetuosas.  La ubicación es buena. Barrio lindo y seguro. La habitación que ocupé tiene mucho espacio de guardado, la cama es realmente muy confortable.  Y a pesar de que el tren pasa por el puente que está ubicado a pocos metros de la casa, es un ambiente tranquilo y permite descansar bien.

This is a great little place, perfect for a week of exploring Buenos Aires! Vicky is extremely helpful, always available for questions, and organized a smooth check-in. The apartment is tastefully decorated and has all you need for a city vacation. The kitchen is equipped for preparing small meals and snacks; the bathroom and shower are clean and well-kept. The apartment's location is very central and next to subway and buses.

Esta muy central y cerca de toda en el barrio santelmo y a 10 minutos del centro, muy buena ubicacion y calidad de servicio y infraestructura entregada es la misma a lo visto, muy optima y todo limpio recomendable a ojos cerrados y

We stayed 3 nights in Amilcar's flat and it was great experience. The place is very well equipped and looked after. The location is super handy and very nice neighbourhood. Amilcar gave us very good tips on what to do and how to move around the city and the communication was very good too. Highly recommended place.

Irma is very friendly person with big heart! Very helpfull. She’s son give us a lot of tips and information about Buenos Aires. Localisation is save. Flat is very clean and have amazing terrace! U can feel a beautiful soul here ! Fully recomend!
Hermoso el dpto, muy cómodo, tiene todo lo necesario para pasarlo bien,. María Belén nos espero personalmente y estuvo atenta a todos los detalles. La ubicación muy buena . Super recomendable.
El departamento súper bien distribuido y en una zona de fácil acceso a otros atractivos turísticos en Buenos Aires. Muy buen ambiente.

Uma única observação: Brian me ofereceu um serviço de taxi do aeroporto ao apartamento, por US$ 45. Uma dic: não recomendo o serviço de taxi oferecido, já que o custo de táxi até o aeroporto é de 80 pesos. Me senti bastante chateada por isso.

Very mixed feeling about my stay, not related to the apartment itself. I faced several issues with the host instead. 1-lack of wifi - the host was not interested of fixing the issue on his own. After reporting lack of the internet, he told me to call the provider on my own and figure out the issue. I found out that the internet was unpaid. Once the internet was connected again, I was having low connection issues and again, no internet until end of my stay. Next, the gym, that is listed as one of the amenities simply doesn't exist. The only machine that is there was broken from the day one and still after sending the hosts photos, he claimed the gym was working perfectly and if i have issues I need to find a building (Website hidden by Airbnb) Following - sheets, blankets and towels. All of the sheets and towels were in the closet for a really long time. For this reason they were very dusty and not really ready to be used. I had to wash them the day I arrived. Sadly, Ignacio has no designated person to go to the apartament in case of an emergency or apartament related issues when he is not in town. He was on vacation while I was at the apartament, which is ok, but he was forcing me to wait until he comes back to return the keys to the apartament when I wanted to check out... He also claimed I have left AC on when I checked out, not making any point out of it because Buenos Aires in December is humid and 33 C...plus he claimed I have torn some curtain. Well, I just advise you to record a video or take photos before and after... I did record a video how I left the place and sent it to the support team, which was a great idea to do so. Finally, be aware that the host really is not interested on helping you. Not just the overall apartament issues, but overall I do not think he is a good person. He only is to rent the apartment, leaving all to you... and collect his money. I have rented this place for 3 months ahead, in the first 6 days of my stay I have lost my job and had to plan to return to my country. I have informed Ignacio immediately, but in short he says he simply doesn't care and he will charge me for the additional 2 months no matter what, even when I am not going to be there...then also I got several messages from him "why I am not canceling?" - in short, the experiences I was facing were not really related to the apartament, but to the host himself. Maybe this place is good for you if you are there just for a short stay...but not for a long run. Thanks to the airbnb support team, I have solved all of the issues and was able to recover my money for the unused days and also was partially refunded for the affected days where I had no internet. I would not stay with Ignacio again.
